title: Executive Assistant
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, proactive, and mission-aligned Executive Assistant to directly support the CEO.



This role exists to protect the CEO's capacity for strategic work, including fundraising, partnerships, program expansion, and organizational growth. The Executive Assistant handles the administrative and operational infrastructure that keeps leadership moving efficiently while also serving as a key contributor to grant development and management in partnership with the organization's grant lead.



This is NOT an entry-level administrative position. We are seeking an experienced Executive Assistant who can confidently support executive leadership, manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, and operate independently in a fast-paced environment. While every organization has its own processes and systems, candidates should already possess strong Executive Assistant fundamentals and experience supporting senior leaders.



SCHEDULE



* Part-time position

* Monday through Friday

* 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM EST

* Opportunity for additional hours and expanded responsibilities as the organization grows



LEADING PEOPLE



You do not manage a team, but you represent the CEO's office in every interaction.



Your professionalism, responsiveness, discretion, and follow-through reflect directly on the organization's leadership. You will be trusted with sensitive information, key relationships, organizational priorities, and executive communications. This role requires maturity, professionalism, and a high level of integrity.



DELIVERING RESULTS



* CEO calendar is managed proactively with meetings scheduled, conflicts resolved, and preparation materials organized in advance.

* Follow-up items from CEO meetings are tracked, assigned, and completed without requiring the CEO to reinitiate action.

* CEO inbox is actively managed with communications sorted, prioritized, and monitored to ensure timely responses.

* Active partnerships, grants, and community relationships are maintained in a living tracking system with current status updates and next steps documented.

* Organizational priorities are coordinated across teams with the CEO informed and never surprised.

* Grant opportunities are researched and presented to leadership on a regular basis.

* Grant applications, proposals, Letters of Intent (LOIs), one-pagers, and supporting documentation are prepared, submitted, and maintained accurately and on time.

* Grant reporting requirements, compliance deadlines, and supporting records are maintained in an organized, audit-ready system.

* Leverages AI and automation tools appropriately to streamline administrative processes, improve efficiency, and reduce manual workload while maintaining accuracy and quality.

* Administrative burden on leadership is measurably reduced through strong ownership and execution.



COMMUNICATION



* Serve as the first point of contact for the CEO's office, including scheduling requests,
 communications, and external inquiries.

* Own the day-to-day management of the CEO's inbox, including prioritization, organization, drafting responses, and ensuring no communication falls through the cracks.

* Partner closely with the organization's grant lead to support grant writing coordination, deadlines, submissions, and documentation.

* Ensure internal teams receive clear communication regarding CEO priorities, decisions, and expectations.

* Handle sensitive communications with confidentiality and sound judgment.

* Document action items, commitments, and decisions from CEO meetings and ensure appropriate follow-up.



STRATEGIC THINKING



* Understand the CEO's priorities well enough to make informed decisions regarding scheduling, access, and time management.

* Anticipate needs before meetings, events, deadlines, and major initiatives.

* Monitor funding opportunities and trends relevant to the organization's mission and programs.

* Identify administrative inefficiencies and recommend practical solutions that improve organizational effectiveness.



ACCOUNTABILITY



* Provide weekly executive briefings that include calendar updates, open action items, grant deadlines, and partnership status reports.

* Ensure no grant deadline or compliance requirement is missed without advance notice and a documented plan.

* Maintain accurate and current records within all tracking and CRM systems.

* Ensure executive communications and follow-up expectations are consistently met.

* Protect CEO capacity by owning responsibilities that should not require executive involvement.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Minimum of 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Executive Coordinator, Project Coordinator, Administrative Operations Professional, or similar role.

* Demonstrated experience directly supporting senior executives, founders, CEOs, or C-suite leadership.

* Strong executive calendar management and inbox management experience.

* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, projects, and stakeholders simultaneously.

* Experience working in a fast-paced, mission-driven, nonprofit, startup, or growth-oriented environment.

* Strong organizational and project management skills.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Experience using project management, collaboration, and CRM systems.

* Comfortable working with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar platforms to support research, communication, organization, documentation, and administrative efficiency.

* High degree of discretion, trustworthiness, professionalism, and sound judgment.

* Strong alignment with the organization's mission of supporting underrepresented talent in technology.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Experience with grant research, grant writing, or nonprofit grant management.

* Familiarity with federal, state, corporate, and foundation funding opportunities.

* Experience coordinating cross-functional projects and organizational initiatives.

* Experience supporting a founder, CEO, or executive leadership team.

* Familiarity with HubSpot, Notion, Asana, Jira, Google Workspace, or similar platforms.



IMMEDIATE HIRE OPPORTUNITY



This is an immediate-hire opportunity for a candidate who can step into the role with confidence and professionalism. We are seeking someone who already understands the fundamentals of executive support and can quickly contribute to the success of the CEO and organization.



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered for this position, applicants must submit all of the following:



1. A current resume that includes complete employment history with start and end dates for each position.



2. A professional portfolio showcasing relevant work, accomplishments, projects, or case studies that demonstrate Executive Assistant, operations, project coordination, executive support, or organizational management experience.



3. A detailed introduction video that includes:



* Your Executive Assistant experience

* The executives or leaders you have supported

* Examples of complex responsibilities you have managed

* Why are you interested in this opportunity

* Why do you believe you are a strong fit for this role



4. Must use at least 10 apply points to be considered.



Applications that do not include all three required components will not be reviewed. Attention to detail is critical in this role, and complete application submissions are part of the evaluation process.

Final Cut Pro

The role will start with a paid trial period so we can make sure you are the right fit. If you perform well, this can turn into a full-time long-term position with room for raises, promotions, and more responsibility inside the company.



We are looking for someone who:



Has strong short-form editing skills

Can follow direction and improve quickly

Communicates well

Is available full-time

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Please read out short description in full. Or you'll miss important detail. 



We're a new company to fashion industry in the USA which brings herritage European designs with a modern touch of convenience. 



We're hiring one person to drive growth across both sides of the business: closing wholesale relationships and managing our retail presence, while also owning the social and content voice that brings our DTC brand to life.



Please start your cover letter with "I speak perfect English". That needs to be true and also shows us that you read the post. All other appicants will be ignored. 



This is a hybrid sales-and-marketing seat, split roughly evenly between two functions:



B2B Sales & Outreach (~50%)



Directly contact boutiques, independent retailers, and resellers to pitch wholesale partnerships (we have a list). 

Manage the full outreach cycle: prospecting, cold
/DM outreach, follow-up, negotiation, onboarding.

Maintain a pipeline of leads and partner accounts (CRM or structured tracker).

Represent the brand professionally in every external communication — tone and polish matter.

Support marketplace account management as we expand to wholesale platforms.



B2C Marketing & Content (~50%)

Plan and execute social media for Beltori (Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest) — content calendar, captions, community engagement, trend awareness

Write and optimize product listings and on-site copy for our Shopify store, with SEO best practices for luxury/fashion search intent

Stay current on retail and fashion e-commerce trends and suggest campaigns, collabs, or content formats that fit our brand voice

Collaborate with the founder on launches, seasonal campaigns, and brand storytelling





What We're Looking For



Fluent, polished English — written and spoken. This is non-negotiable: you'll be writing customer-facing copy and pitching real business partners. Native English not required if your fluency is excellent.

Proven e-commerce and/or sales experience — outreach, account management, or DTC marketing background. Direct fashion/luxury experience is a strong plus, not a requirement.

Social media fluency — you understand platform-specific content (not just posting the same thing everywhere) and can speak to current trends without being told what they are.

Shopify familiarity — comfortable editing listings, understanding storefront basics; admin experience preferred.

SEO literacy — understands on-page SEO for product and content pages, especially how it applies to fashion/luxury search behavior (keyword intent, descriptive copy that still converts).

Self-directed — this is a founder-led startup; you'll need to work independently, propose ideas, and manage your own pipeline without heavy oversight.

Comfortable with both cold outreach and creative work — the split matters. We need someone who won't burn out doing sales
s one day and content calendars the next.



Compensation will be a combination of competitive hourly rate (up to $5/hour) plus bonus based on results. 



Nice to have:





Experience with wholesale platforms (e.g., Faire) or retail marketplaces

A portfolio or examples of past social content / product copy you've written

Familiarity with CRM or outreach tools (any — we're not locked into a specific stack yet)

title: Part-Time Sales Coach (Phone/Voice) — US Medical Sales
description:
We have two phone reps who need daily coaching on delivery and tonality. Scripts and methods are already built — you won't redesign anything. You make them sound sharp at what we already have.



-  Rep 1 — Inbound Closer: patients call in about a knee treatment. Warm, premium, consultative. The job is converting interest into a booking.

-  Rep 2 — Outbound Setter: cold-calls clinic managers to book demos. Light and quick. The job is earning the meeting.



One short session with each, every morning, before their calls start: review their recent recordings, then drill the 1–2 things each needs — tone, pacing, warmth, certainty, pauses. Plus a short weekly note to me.

---



REQUIRED (only apply if you have actually done these):

- ? Coached phone/voice sales — live calls, not chat or

- ? Worked specifically on tonality and delivery — pace, stress, warmth, certainty — not just scripts and rebuttals

- ? Experience with both inbound conversion AND outbound cold-calling

- ? Background as Sales QA, Trainer, or Team Lead in a BPO, on US/Canada voice accounts

- ? You can hear a flat or "salesy" line and  model the better version yourself, out loud

---



TO APPLY:

1. Record a short voice clip. Read these four lines the way each is described — and after each, say in one sentence why you delivered it that way:

a) Acknowledge, then pivot. Warm agreement that matches the patient and does NOT argue — then a gentle turn into a question: "I hear you — the drive is a real thing. Can I ask you something, though? If distance wasn't a factor, would this be something you'd want to do for your knee?"

b) Soft and sincere. Slow it down, almost a whisper, like you genuinely care and want to reassure them: "I'm so glad we got this booked for you — you're going to be in great hands with our doctor. You did the right thing reaching out, and I promise we'll take good care of you."

c) Mystery / a secret just for her. Drop your voice low and slow, like you're letting her in on something: "The reason I'm calling, John, is that Dr. Bart built a system for clinics just like yours — so your staff isn't running around, everyone gets coordinated automatically and your billings go up."

2. Tell me about one inbound or outbound account you've coached — and one specific delivery problem you fixed.

3. Tell me your monthly rate (USD).???



*Applications without the voice recording won't be reviewed.*

title: Founding Technical Partner to Architect a Self-Healing, Al-Operated Company on AWS (Revenue Share + Exit Stake)
description:
This is not a task on a list. This is the engine.

I am building TalkTuit, an AI communications platform for the trades, plumbing and HVAC first. The product is the entry point. The real company is something rarer: a business that largely runs itself, where AI agents find leads, build and deliver each client's system, onboard them, watch the numbers, and repair their own failures before anyone notices.

I need one person, or one tight team, to architect and build that engine on AWS. Not a piece of it. The whole thing.

A bit about why this matters to me, because it tells you what kind of partner I am. I came up in the trades. About ten years ago a spinal cord injury left me quadriplegic, and I run this entire company by voice. I know exactly what it feels like to miss the phone while you are buried in a job, because I have lived both sides of it. I am not looking for hands to rent. I am looking for a great engineer who wants to keep doing what they are great at, on something that actually means something, and own a real piece of the outcome.

What you would build

The depth here is real, so I will be straight about it:

 The voice layer: production grade AI voice agents (Retell, Vapi, ElevenLabs, Twilio) that answer, book, route, and summarize calls and sound genuinely human.

 The integration layer: connect those agents to ANY CRM a client already runs, through APIs and webhooks, never locked to one platform.

 The automation layer: end to end workflows (n8n and similar) that onboard clients, sync data, and run the business with as little human touch as possible.

 The growth engine: an automated demo system where a prospect replies to an
 and, within minutes, the system provisions a number, builds a personalized voice demo from their website, and sends it to them to try.

 The self-healing layer: monitoring and recovery so each client system and each internal system diagnoses and repairs itself, plus a recurring automated audit that catches problems before the client ever sees them.

 All of it on AWS, data rich, cost efficient at scale, documented, and clean enough to transfer at an exit.

Who you are

 You have built and shipped real production systems on AWS, not just demos.

 You live in AI agents and automation, and you can reason about architecture, not just wire up tools.

 Voice AI experience is a strong plus. CRM and API integration experience is a strong plus.

 You can work mostly independently and own outcomes, with some overlap with US Eastern time for working sessions.

 A person or a small team is both fine. If you bring a bench, even better.

This is a partnership, not a job

So we do not waste each other's time: this is structured as a partnership for the right fit. Revenue share that begins when revenue does, plus participation in the company's exit. Real upside, tied to what you help build, with the heavy lifting front loaded and the rewards compounding behind it. I keep majority ownership and control. You get a stake worth caring about. We talk specifics once we both know it is a fit.

If you want a steady hourly ticket with daily tasks handed to you, this honestly is not it, and that is okay.

The honest bar

I have interviewed a lot of people. This is one final round to find the rare fit I have not met yet. If the scope excited you instead of scaring you, I want to hear from you.

How to apply

Start your message with the word BUILT so I know you read this all the way through. Then tell me, in your own words:

 The most complex system you have built on AWS, and your specific role in it.

 Whether you work solo or bring a team, and who does what.

 One thing in the scope above you would architect differently, and why.

Show me something real you have built if you can. I read every serious message myself.

Let us build something that should not be possible.

title: Suno Music Creation VA for YouTube, Canva, and AI Content Workflow

We are looking for a creative and highly skilled Virtual Assistant with advanced experience using Suno to create music for YouTube and other music platforms. This is not a basic VA role. The VA should also be able to help prepare and coordinate music releases for other platforms, including Spotify, Amazon Music, and similar streaming services. The VA should be comfortable preparing music files, cover artwork, song titles, artist names, descriptions, release dates, genres, and metadata for publishing. They should also be able to track release dates, platform links, and publishing status in an organized content tracker.

title: Amazon Product Sourcing VA / Online Arbitrage Product Researcher
description:
I am looking for a detail-oriented Amazon Product Sourcing VA to help find profitable products for an Amazon resale business.



Your main responsibility will be finding profitable product leads using storefront sourcing / storefront stalking.



The process is simple but requires attention to detail:



You will start with an Amazon seller storefront, go through the products they are selling, use SellerAmp to check if the products meet our criteria, and then search online to find where those products can be purchased profitably.



When you find a winning product, you will then look at other sellers on that same Amazon listing, open their storefronts, and repeat the process.



The goal is to continuously find profitable products that meet our buying criteria and submit them clearly in a Google Sheet for review.



?



Main Responsibilities



* Review Amazon seller storefronts to find potential products

* Use SellerAmp to analyze products

* Check sales rank, monthly sales, offer count, warnings, Amazon competition, and price history

* Avoid products with IP complaint warnings, private label warnings, weak demand, or unstable pricing

* Search Google Shopping and Google Search to find profitable buying sources

* Check retail websites, promo codes, coupon codes, and simple discounts

* Calculate profitability using SellerAmp

* Add qualified product leads to a Google Sheet

* Include the Amazon link, ASIN, source link, buy cost, selling price, estimated profit, ROI, and notes

* Follow a repeatable process every day



?



Product Criteria



You will be looking for products that meet these criteria:



* Amazon sales rank under 200,000

* At least 100 estimated sales per month

* No IP complaint warning

* No private label warning

* Amazon is not selling the product, or Amazon is not price competitive

* Stable selling price

* Competition is not increasing rapidly while price is falling

* Monthly sales should ideally be at least 3x the number of competing offers

* Product can be purchased from a legitimate retail website

* Product has at least 30% ROI after estimated shipping cost



For calculations, we will use a fixed estimated shipping cost of $1.50.



?



What You Will Submit



For every qualified lead, you will submit:



* Amazon product title

* ASIN

* Amazon listing link

* Source website link

* Buy cost

* Estimated shipping cost

* Amazon selling price used

* Estimated profit

* ROI percentage

* Monthly sales

* Sales rank

* Number of sellers/offers

* Whether Amazon is on the listing

* Promo code used, if any

* Notes or concerns



The source link is very important. Do not submit a product unless you found where it can be purchased profitably.



?



Required Skills



* Experience with Amazon product research

* Experience with SellerAmp preferred

* Experience with Keepa preferred

* Experience with online arbitrage preferred

* Strong Google research skills

* Comfortable using Google Sheets

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to follow clear criteria

* Ability to work independently

* Good written English

* Reliable internet connection

* Own laptop or desktop computer



?



Nice to Have



* Experience sourcing for Amazon FBA or FBM

* Experience with storefront stalking / storefront sourcing

* Experience using coupon tools or promo code research

* Experience calculating ROI and profit margins

* Understanding of sales rank, Buy Box, Keepa charts, and Amazon competition



?



Who This Is For



This role is for someone who is patient, detail-oriented, and good at repetitive research.



I do not need someone who guesses. I need someone who can follow criteria, check the numbers carefully, and submit clean product leads that are easy to review.

title: Market Research & Investment Research Virtual Assistant
description:
Market Research & Investment Research Virtual Assistant



Company: NextVerra

Position: Market Research & Investment Research Virtual Assistant

Type: Part-Time or Full-Time

Schedule: U.S. market hours preferred

Location: Remote

Pay: Starting at $4–$6/hr depending on experience and skill level



About the Role



We are looking for a detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help monitor the stock market, organize daily market research, prepare trading watchlists, and complete weekly deep-dive research reports on companies we are considering for long-term investment.



This is a research and reporting role only. You will not be giving financial advice, making investment decisions, placing trades, managing money, or telling us what to buy or sell.



The ideal candidate is reliable, organized, fast with research, interested in the stock market, and able to summarize complex information in a simple, clear way.



Main Responsibilities



Your work will include two main areas:



1. Daily market research and watchlist preparation

2. Weekly company deep-dive research for potential long-term holds



Daily Market Research Responsibilities



Each day, you may be responsible for:



* Monitoring pre-market movers

* Finding stocks with unusual volume

* Tracking stocks with major news or catalysts

* Reviewing earnings announcements

* Tracking analyst upgrades and downgrades

* Watching major ETFs such as SPY, QQQ, and sector ETFs

* Identifying stocks that match our written criteria

* Preparing a daily watchlist

* Summarizing why each stock is moving

* Identifying basic support and resistance levels

* Tracking risk factors for each ticker

* Organizing source links for all research

* Maintaining a trading research spreadsheet

* Tracking hypothetical/paper trade ideas for review

* Creating end-of-day performance summaries



Weekly Long-Term Company Research



Each week, you will complete one detailed research report on a company we choose.



The purpose of this report is to help us understand the company better as a possible long-term investment. You will not recommend whether to buy or sell. Your job is to provide clear, organized research.



Each weekly company report should include:



* Company overview

* Ticker symbol and exchange

* What the company does

* Main products or services

* How the company makes money

* Revenue streams

* Target customers

* Industry overview

* Market size and growth potential

* Main competitors

* Competitive advantages

* Weaknesses or disadvantages

* Leadership team overview

* Recent earnings summary

* Revenue growth trends

* Profitability trends

* Debt and cash position

* Free cash flow overview, if available

* Valuation overview

* Analyst opinions and price targets

* Recent news and catalysts

* Insider buying or selling, if available

* Institutional ownership, if available

* Bull case

* Bear case

* Major risks

* Long-term growth opportunities

* Key questions we should answer before considering an investment

* Final neutral summary of whether the company appears strong, weak, risky, or worth watching further



The report should include source links and be written in simple language that a business owner can understand.



Important Role Boundaries



This position is for research, organization, and reporting only.



You will not:



* Give financial advice

* Tell us what to buy or sell

* Place trades

* Access brokerage accounts

* Manage investment accounts

* Guarantee profits

* Be paid based on trading results

* Make final investment decisions



All trading and investing decisions are made internally.



Tools You May Use



Experience with these tools is preferred, but not required:



* TradingView

* Finviz

* Yahoo Finance

* MarketWatch

* CNBC

* Benzinga

* Seeking Alpha

* Google Finance

* SEC filings

* Company investor relations pages

* Earnings call transcripts

* Google Sheets

* Google Docs

* ChatGPT or other AI research tools



Required Skills



We are looking for someone who has:



* Strong English reading and writing skills

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to follow written instructions exactly

* Ability to research quickly and accurately

* Basic understanding of stocks and financial markets

* Basic understanding of charts, volume, catalysts, and news

* Ability to summarize complex information clearly

* Experience using Google Sheets and Google Docs

* Reliable communication during work hours

* High integrity and honesty

* Willingness to learn our process

* Ability to admit when you do not know something



Preferred Experience



Bonus points if you have experience with:



* Stock market research

* Day trading research

* Long-term investment research

* Technical analysis

* Fundamental analysis

* Reading earnings reports

* Reading financial statements

* Preparing investment summaries

* Maintaining trading journals

* Building research dashboards

* Working as a VA for a business owner, trader, investor, or finance company



Experience is helpful, but honesty, accuracy, speed, and coachability are more important.



Daily Report Example



A daily market report may include:



* Overall market summary

* SPY and QQQ trend summary

* Top pre-market movers

* Top stocks with unusual volume

* Stocks with major news catalysts

* Earnings movers

* Analyst upgrades/downgrades

* Sector strength or weakness

* Watchlist tickers that match our written criteria

* Key levels to watch

* Risk notes

* Source links

* End-of-day recap



Weekly Report Example



A weekly company research assignment may look like this:



Research Tesla, Nvidia, Palantir, Apple, Amazon, or another company of our choosing as a potential long-term hold.



Do not recommend whether to buy or sell. Create a complete research report covering the company’s business model, financial health, growth opportunities, risks, competition, valuation, leadership, recent earnings, recent news, bull case, bear case, and key questions we should answer before considering an investment.



Ideal Candidate



You may be a great fit if you:



* Enjoy studying the market

* Like researching companies

* Are naturally curious

* Are highly organized

* Can follow a checklist every day

* Communicate quickly

* Are honest and reliable

* Like turning messy information into simple summaries

* Want a long-term role with room to grow

* Are comfortable working during U.S. market hours



Work Schedule



U.S. market hours are preferred.



Ideal availability would include some or all of the following:



* Pre-market research before the U.S. market opens

* Market monitoring during U.S. market hours

* End-of-day recap after market close

* Weekly company research report submitted by the agreed deadline



We are open to part-time or full-time depending on experience and availability.



Compensation



Starting pay is $4–$6 per hour, depending on experience, communication skills, research ability, and performance on the test task.



There is room for growth for the right person.



How to Apply



Please respond with the following:



1. Your experience with stock market research or investing

2. Your experience with day trading research, if any

3. Your experience with long-term company research, if any

4. Tools or websites you have used for market research

5. Your experience with Google Sheets and Google Docs

6. Your availability during U.S. market hours

7. Your expected hourly rate

8. Your internet speed and computer setup

9. A short explanation of how you would research a stock that is moving up quickly before market open

10. A short explanation of how you would research a company as a possible long-term investment



Please include the word WATCHLIST in your application so we know you read the full post.



Screening Questions



Please answer these questions:



1. Have you ever researched stocks before? Explain your experience.

2. What websites or tools would you use to find pre-market movers?

3. What does trading volume tell you?

4. What is a market catalyst?

5. What is the difference between a short-term trade setup and a long-term investment idea?

6. What is support and resistance?

7. What financial information would you review when researching a company for a long-term hold?

8. What would you look for in a company’s earnings report?

9. How would you summarize negative news about a company?

10. Are you comfortable working during U.S. market hours?

11. Are you comfortable following a strict checklist?

12. Do you understand that this role does not involve giving financial advice, placing trades, or managing money?

13. Why do you think you would be good at this role?



Paid Test Task



Before hiring, we may ask you to complete a paid test task.



Part 1: Daily Market Research Test



Choose 3 stocks moving pre-market today.



For each stock, provide:



* Ticker

* Company name

* Current price

* Pre-market percentage move

* Volume

* Reason it is moving

* Main news catalyst

* Key support and resistance levels

* Risk notes

* Source links



Do not recommend whether to buy or sell. Only provide research.



Part 2: Long-Term Company Research Test



Choose one public company and create a short research report.



Include:



* Company overview

* How the company makes money

* Main products or services

* Recent revenue trend

* Profitability overview

* Debt/cash position

* Main competitors

* Bull case

* Bear case

* Main risks

* Recent news

* Source links

* Final neutral summary



Do not recommend whether to buy or sell. Only provide research.



Final Note



This role is ideal for someone who wants to grow as a market research assistant and help organize useful information for better decision-making.



We are looking for someone long-term who is honest, detail-oriented, fast, accurate, and coachable.

Position

Webflow Developer / Website Designer / Systems Integrator

Type

Project-based + possible ongoing retainer for updates and improvements

















Start Date

ASAP

Rate

Please include fixed-price proposal in your application









Tools We Are Using

These tools are already chosen. Your job is to implement them well, not choose alternatives.



Website + CMS

Webflow — all public pages, CMS collections, and design

Contracts + Payments

HoneyBook — inquiry forms, proposals, contracts, e-signature, payment plans, onboarding automations

Scheduling

HoneyBook built-in scheduler, connected with Google Calendar where appropriate

AI Chatbot

Tidio or Chatbase (developer to evaluate and recommend — see chatbot section below)

Counseling Portal

CounselMore — linked from the site; stays separate at launch

Calendar

Google Calendar via HoneyBook calendar sync

Analytics

Google Analytics 4 + Google Search Console


Google Workspace, already existing









What We Are NOT Looking For

Please do not propose any of the following. These decisions are already made.



A custom SaaS platform

A custom student or parent portal

A custom CRM

A custom payment system or payment plan builder

A custom scheduling system

A replacement for HoneyBook

A replacement for CounselMore

A custom backend or database unless there is a specific reason discussed and agreed upfront



If your instinct is to build something custom that an existing tool already handles — that is not what this project needs. We want clean integrations with great tools, not reinvention.









Website Pages

The first version of the site should include the following pages. We are open to your recommendations on structure if you believe a different layout will convert better. We will provide core business information, service details, and draft copy. We expect the developer/designer to help structure pages for clarity, conversion, and parent-friendly flow. Copywriting or messaging strategy experience is a plus.



Home — see Hero Video Background requirement below

Services / Packages

About Leah / About College Career Pathways

How It Works — the college counseling process, step by step

Resources / Blog

FAQ

Testimonials

Contact

Book a Consultation — HoneyBook scheduler embed or link

Get Started / Enroll — package selection leading into HoneyBook contract and payment flow

Client Portal / Existing Client Login — clean branded page linking to CounselMore

Parent / Student Next Steps — what happens after signing up







Homepage Hero — Video Background with Overlay

The homepage hero section should feature a full-width looping video background with an emotional, conversion-focused headline and a single CTA button — similar in approach to what Crimson Education uses at 
. This is the first thing a parent sees. It sets the tone for the entire brand.



What to Build

Full-width, full-viewport video background playing silently and looping automatically

Semi-transparent dark overlay on top of the video so headline text is clearly readable

Bold centered headline — example: "Your Student’s College Story Starts Here" or similar emotional, outcome-focused copy

Subheadline below — one line describing who we help and what we do

Single CTA button — example: "Book a Free Consultation" or "Get Started" — linking to HoneyBook scheduler

Graceful mobile fallback — on mobile, replace the video with a high-quality static image so load times are not impacted

Video must be compressed and optimized for web — no large uncompressed files that slow the page



Video Source Options

We will provide professional video footage if available. If not, the developer should source appropriate licensed stock video for our approval before use. Recommended free and low-cost sources:



Pexels 
/videos

Free. High quality. Search: students, college campus, family, education, counseling. No attribution required. Best starting point.



Subscription ~$15/month. Large library of premium education and family footage. Good option if Pexels selection is insufficient.

Pixabay 

Free. Smaller library than Pexels but worth checking for the right tone.

Client-Provided Footage

If Leah has professional photos or video of her own, these should be prioritized over stock — authenticity converts better than stock imagery.





Tone and Feel

The video should feel warm, personal, and aspirational — not corporate or generic. Ideal footage shows:

Students in genuine 
nts — studying, celebrating, visiting campuses, opening acceptance letters

Families in conversation — parents and students together, not posed stock photography

Counseling or mentorship 
nts — one-on-one guidance, focus, and encouragement

College environments — campuses, libraries, lecture halls, graduation



Avoid:

Generic corporate footage, overly posed stock imagery, footage that feels cold or academic rather than warm and human. The video should make a parent feel hopeful and confident, not intimidated.





Technical Requirements

Video format: MP4 (H.264), compressed for web — target under 8MB

Autoplay, muted, loop, playsinline attributes set correctly for all browsers

No audio track — video is purely visual

Mobile fallback: static image displayed instead of video on mobile to preserve load speed

Overlay opacity and headline font size must be adjustable without a full redesign







Webflow CMS Requirements

This is one of the most important requirements in this entire project. Non-technical staff must be able to update important content without contacting a developer, touching code, or breaking the site design.



Required CMS Collections

Services / Packages

Name, description, price, what is included, payment options, HoneyBook booking link per service, featured yes/no, display order

FAQs

Question, answer, category

Testimonials

Client quote, first name only, optional outcome, optional photo

Resources / Blog Posts

Title, body content, category, publish date, author, featured image, SEO title, meta description

Team Bios

Name, credentials, photo, bio text

Homepage Sections

Headline, subheadline, CTA text, CTA link — editable without touching design

Integration Links

HoneyBook booking URL, CounselMore portal URL, chatbot script ID if applicable — updateable without touching code





Hard requirement — no exceptions:

Do not hard-code service names, prices, package descriptions, HoneyBook links, CounselMore portal URL, FAQs, testimonials, or any frequently edited content into static page design blocks. If Leah needs to edit it, it must be a Webflow CMS field.

If normal business updates require a developer, the project does not meet the requirement.





Leah Must Be Able To Do All of the Following Without Developer Help

Change a service price

Add a new service or package

Edit service descriptions and what is included

Add or edit FAQ entries

Add a new testimonial

Publish a new resource or blog post

Update her bio or team information

Update a HoneyBook booking link for any service

Update the CounselMore portal URL

Edit homepage headlines and CTAs where practical







AI Chatbot Integration

We want to add an AI chatbot to the website to help families get quick answers to common questions and route them toward booking a consultation. This is not a custom build — it should be an existing tool embedded into the site via a single script.



What the Chatbot Should Do

Answer common parent and student questions about services, packages, pricing, and the counseling process

Be trainable on our own content — FAQs, services, pricing, how it works — so answers are accurate and on-brand

Route interested families toward booking a consultation — ideally linking to the HoneyBook scheduler

Appear on relevant pages — Home, Services, How It Works, Contact — not necessarily every page

Work cleanly on mobile browsers

Match the College Career Pathways brand as closely as the tool allows



Recommended Tools to Evaluate

We are not locked into a specific tool. The developer should evaluate the following options and recommend the best fit based on cost, ease of training on our content, HoneyBook handoff capability, and mobile experience:





Live chat + AI bot in one platform. Embeds in Webflow via single script. Free tier available; paid from ~$29/month. Good mobile experience. Can hand off to booking link.

Chatbasechatbase.co

Train the bot on your own content — upload FAQs, service descriptions, and pages. Simple embed. From ~$19/month. Answers accurately from your own materials. Recommended if content accuracy is the priority.



Open source, highly customizable. Free to build; self-hosting or cloud. More setup required but most flexible long-term.



AI-powered conversation builder. Mid-range pricing. More structured flows than Tidio or Chatbase.

HoneyBook native

Check whether HoneyBook offers a chat or lead-capture widget that could serve this function natively before adding a third-party tool.





Developer task:

Evaluate the options above, recommend the best fit with reasoning, and include estimated monthly cost in your Phase 0 discovery deliverables. Implementation should be a simple script embed in Webflow — no custom development. The chatbot tool itself is a subscription the business owner will manage; the developer sets it up and trains it on initial content during Phase 1.









HoneyBook Integration

HoneyBook is the core business operations tool. The developer should not build custom payment logic, contract logic, scheduling logic, or onboarding automation. HoneyBook handles all of that.



HoneyBook Handles — Do Not Recreate

Inquiry forms and lead capture

Scheduling and calendar booking

Package proposals

Contracts and e-signature

One-time payments

Payment plans and automatic installment charges

Payment receipts and failed payment handling

Onboarding
 sequences and client reminders

Internal client pipeline and status tracking



What the Developer Builds

Embed or link HoneyBook inquiry form on Contact and Get Started pages

Embed or link HoneyBook scheduler on the Book a Consultation page

Build the Get Started / Enroll flow so it leads cleanly into HoneyBook’s contract and payment process

Ensure all HoneyBook booking links per service are stored in Webflow CMS so Leah can update them without developer help

Style HoneyBook embeds to match the College Career Pathways brand as closely as HoneyBook allows

Test the full client journey end-to-end: inquiry ? booking ? contract ? payment plan ? onboarding







CounselMore — Client Portal Handoff

CounselMore is our student counseling platform. It handles everything after onboarding — student portal, college lists, application tracking, tasks, and document sharing. It stays separate from the website at launch.



At Launch

A clean, branded /client-login page on the website links families to the CounselMore portal. No API integration required.

Developer Task

Build /client-login as a polished, on-brand page with a clear CTA directing existing clients to their portal. The CounselMore URL must be stored as a Webflow CMS Integration Links field so it can be updated without touching code.

Future

If CounselMore offers affordable API or white-label options later, deeper integration can be added on a backend subdomain without rebuilding or modifying any Webflow page. This must be a real architectural guarantee, not just a hope — the way the site is built today must make that future integration straightforward.









Brand Assets & Existing Identity

College Career Pathways has an existing brand identity at 
 that the new site must carry forward and elevate. The developer should review the existing site thoroughly before beginning Phase 0 discovery.



Existing Site to Review

Current website: 

Please review this site before your Phase 0 discovery call. The new site should feel like a premium, polished evolution of what exists — not a departure from it. Families who already know the brand should feel immediately at home.





Existing Brand Elements to Carry Forward

Logo

The existing College Career Pathways logo must be used on the new site. We will provide the original high-resolution file. The logo is already live at 
 and should be treated as the primary brand mark.

Color Scheme

The existing color palette from 
 should be carried into the new design. We will provide exact hex codes. The new site should feel like a premium upgrade of the current brand, not a rebrand.

Brand Voice

Warm, personal, family-centered, and confidence-building. Key phrases from the current site: 'Clear guidance. Real support. Less stress.' and 'The College Roadmap Every Family Deserves.' The new site should maintain this tone throughout.

Existing Copy

Much of the existing page copy — Ms. Leah's bio, testimonials, service descriptions, and value propositions — can be reused and refined. We will provide all current content for the developer to work with.

Social Profiles

,
/X, Instagram, and TikTok accounts exist at the handles shown on the current site. These should be linked from the new site's footer.





What to Elevate

The new site should take the existing brand and make it feel more premium, more conversion-focused, and more modern — without losing the warmth and approachability that defines it. Specific improvements to aim for:



More visual hierarchy and white space — the current site is slightly text-heavy

Stronger calls-to-action at every scroll point — not just at the bottom of the page

Better mobile experience — the current site is functional but not optimized for phones

Hero video background replacing the current static hero — see Hero Video section

More prominent testimonials and social proof

Cleaner service and pricing presentation

Faster load times



Brand Assets the Developer Will Need

High-resolution logo file (PNG with transparent background and SVG if available)

Exact hex color codes for primary, secondary, and accent colors

Current font choices if known — or developer recommends consistent fonts based on existing brand

All existing photos of Ms. Leah and any student/family imagery already owned

All existing written copy from current pages



We will provide all brand assets at the start of Phase 0. Please include a brand asset checklist in your Phase 0 discovery deliverables confirming what you have received and what is still needed before design begins.









Design Requirements

Families visiting this site are making one of the most important decisions of their children’s lives. The design must earn trust immediately.



Homepage hero video background — full-width looping video with overlay text and CTA button (see Hero Video section above)

Modern, clean, and premium — not generic, not template-looking

Warm and parent-friendly — approachable, calm, credible, reassuring

Mobile-first — fully functional and beautiful on iOS Safari and Android Chrome without an app

Fast-loading — optimized images, clean code, minimal unnecessary scripts

Conversion-focused — every page should have a clear next step for the visitor

Trust-building — credentials, testimonials, and social proof placed prominently

SEO-friendly — proper heading hierarchy, meta fields, alt text, clean URL structure

Accessible — follows WCAG 2.1 AA best practices where practical, including readable contrast, alt text, clear form labels, and keyboard-friendly navigation



Please avoid generic template-looking work. We are a premium service business. The design should reflect that immediately.









Mobile Requirements

Parents and students visit from phones. Mobile is not an afterthought — it is a primary design target.



Fast load time on mobile networks

Clear calls-to-action visible without excessive scrolling

Easy navigation — tap-friendly buttons and menus

HoneyBook embedded flows and chatbot must work cleanly on mobile browsers

Forms easy to complete on a phone keyboard

No awkward spacing, tiny text, or broken elements on small screens

Excellent experience on iOS Safari and Android Chrome







SEO Requirements

Clean URL structure

Page titles and meta descriptions for every page

Proper heading hierarchy (H1, H2, H3) throughout

Image alt text on all images

Open Graph images for social sharing

XML sitemap

robots.txt

301 redirects from old URLs if replacing an existing site

Google Analytics 4 connected

Google Search Console connected and verified

Basic local and service-business SEO recommendations provided







Future-Proofing

Build the site so future improvements can be made without a complete rebuild.



CounselMore API integration must remain possible without a site rebuild.

The /client-login page and CounselMore handoff must be built so that a future CounselMore API integration — automated student profile creation, portal invitations, or white-label portal routing — can be added via a backend on a subdomain without modifying any Webflow page. This is a hard architectural requirement, not a nice-to-have. If adding CounselMore API integration later would require rebuilding or significantly modifying the Webflow site, the project does not meet this requirement.





All external URLs — HoneyBook links, CounselMore portal URL, chatbot embed IDs, any future tool links — stored as Webflow CMS fields, not buried in custom code

The /client-login page must be easily updated if CounselMore changes portal options or if we switch counseling platforms

New services, packages, blog posts, FAQs, and testimonials must be addable without developer involvement

New pages must be addable without redesigning the full site

If a lightweight backend is ever needed, it should be addable on a subdomain such as 
 without modifying the Webflow marketing site

Do not build unnecessary custom code — keep the Webflow build clean and standard







Deliverables

Phase 0 — Discovery (1–2 Weeks)

Review current website, brand assets, services, and packages

Map complete client journey from inquiry to CounselMore onboarding

Confirm HoneyBook embed and link options for each integration point

Evaluate and recommend AI chatbot tool with reasoning and estimated monthly cost

Define all Webflow CMS collections and their required fields

Page-by-page layout plan or wireframes for approval before design begins

Confirm what content we need to provide

Timeline and milestone breakdown for Phase 1



Phase 1 — Website Build (4–6 Weeks)

All pages built in Webflow per scope above

All Webflow CMS collections configured and populated with initial content

HoneyBook inquiry form embedded or linked on Contact and Get Started pages

HoneyBook scheduler embedded or linked on Book a Consultation page

Get Started / Enroll flow connected to HoneyBook contract and payment process

AI chatbot embedded and trained on initial content — FAQs, services, pricing, how it works

Chatbot routing to HoneyBook booking link configured

CounselMore /client-login page built with CMS-managed portal URL

Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console connected

Full SEO setup — meta, headings, alt text, sitemap, redirects

Mobile testing across iOS Safari and Android Chrome

Full client journey tested end-to-end before launch

Site published to 



Phase 2 — Training & Handoff

60–90 minute live Webflow CMS training session with Leah

Screen-recorded walkthrough covering: adding services, changing prices, publishing blog posts, adding FAQs, adding testimonials, updating HoneyBook links, updating the CounselMore portal URL — required deliverable, not optional

Written quick-reference guide for common Webflow CMS tasks — required deliverable, not optional

Brief walkthrough of how to update chatbot content as services and FAQs change

30-day post-launch bug-fix support



Ongoing Retainer — Optional After Launch

After launch we may want ongoing help with design updates, new pages, SEO improvements, HoneyBook flow improvements, and deeper integrations as the business grows. Please confirm whether you are available for ongoing support.







Requirements

Must Have

Strong Webflow design and build experience — portfolio required

Non-negotiable. Please show examples in your application.

Strong Webflow CMS experience — building collections non-technical users manage comfortably

Ability to build polished, professional service-business websites — not generic templates

Experience embedding third-party tools — forms, schedulers, payment flows, chat widgets, client portals

Mobile-first design

SEO fundamentals

Clear English communication

Ability to work independently and make practical recommendations

Ability to train a non-technical business owner to manage their own site



Strongly Preferred

Prior HoneyBook experience

AI chatbot setup experience — Tidio, Chatbase, or similar

Experience with service businesses — consultants, coaches, tutors, healthcare, education, professional services

Google Analytics 4 setup experience

Basic SEO and conversion optimization knowledge

Figma experience

Basic copywriting or messaging strategy skills







Ideal Candidate

You are a good fit if you:



Have excellent Webflow design and build skills with a portfolio to prove it

Understand Webflow CMS deeply and set it up so non-technical users manage content comfortably

Build clean, polished, professional websites — not generic templates

Think about user experience and conversion — every page moves a visitor toward the next step

Can integrate third-party tools cleanly through links, embeds, and script tags

Communicate clearly, work independently, and make practical recommendations

Understand the difference between a marketing website and a custom software platform

Can train a non-technical business owner to manage their own site confidently







How to Apply

Generic applications will not be reviewed. Please send all of the following:



Portfolio and Background

1.  Your Webflow portfolio or website — live links strongly preferred

2.  Two to three examples of service-business websites you built in Webflow

3.  Any Webflow CMS examples where a non-technical client manages their own content

4.  Any experience with HoneyBook, Calendly, or similar scheduling, contract, payment, or onboarding tools

5.  Any experience setting up AI chatbots — Tidio, Chatbase, or similar



Questions About This Project

6.  How would you structure the Webflow CMS collections so Leah can add a new service package — including name, description, price, what is included, and HoneyBook booking link — without any developer help?

7.  How would you connect the Get Started / Enroll page to HoneyBook’s contract and payment process? Walk us through the parent’s experience from clicking the button to completing their payment plan setup.

8.  Which AI chatbot tool would you recommend for this project and why? What would it cost per month?

9.  How would you make the /client-login page easy to update if the CounselMore portal URL changes or if we ever switch platforms?

10.  How would you make sure this site stays easy for a non-technical business owner to maintain long after you finish building it?

11.  How would you structure the site so a future backend integration could be added on a subdomain without rebuilding the Webflow marketing site?

12.  What do you need from us before you can start?



Logistics

13.  Your proposed timeline — broken out by Phase 0 (discovery), Phase 1 (build), Phase 2 (training and handoff)

14.  Your rate —  fixed-price

15.  Your availability — hours per week, preferred working hours, expected start date

16.  A short paragraph about yourself and why this project is a good fit for you



We are looking for a long-term partner, not a one-time contractor.

College Career Pathways is a growing counseling practice. The right developer becomes our go-to person for future pages, improvements, and integrations as the business grows.

We communicate clearly, respect your time, and pay on time. We hope you bring the same.

title: Elite AI VSL Video Editor for Direct Response Meta Ads ($6 to $8+ per video)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



I am hiring a few elite AI VSL editors, and I am ready to pay for real talent. If you are one of the best at editing and creating direct response Meta ads, keep reading. If you are a general editor or a beginner, please do not apply or message me.



Do NOT apply if you are not an experienced direct response Meta or
 ads editor. I am not looking for cheap. I am looking for the best, and I will pay accordingly.



-------------------------------------------

THE ROLE IN ONE LINE



I send you a script I wrote, a 60 second Loom, and sometimes a reference video. You go and build a finished direct response VSL that beats the reference and is ready to run with zero fixing fro
.



-------------------------------------------

WHO WE ARE



We are the number one brand in our DTC product category and one of the biggest advertisers in our space. We are scaling fast and we need a small team of editors who can ship winning ads quickly and consistently.



-------------------------------------------

THE STYLES YOU MUST BE ELITE AT



This role is for specialists, not generalists. You must be excellent at at least one of these, and ideally all of them. The more of these you can do at a high level, the more I want you and the more I will pay you.



- Voiceover b-roll style VSLs (our core format)

- Clay style AI animation

- Skeleton style AI animation

- Pixar style AI animation



If all you can do is basic talking-head cuts, this is not for you.



-------------------------------------------

YOU PROMPT EVERYTHING YOURSELF



You write your own prompts and you get elite results out of them. I am not going to prompt for you. I tell you "we need to make this," and you already know the software, the workflow, and how to prompt it to a high standard.



- You prompt hyper realistic AI video yourself in Veo3, Grok, Kling, Seedance, and similar models, and you know which tool is best for which shot.

- You prompt your own AI images so they look real, not like AI slop.

- You prompt the best AI voices in ElevenLabs and build clean, real-sounding AI avatars in HeyGen, with lipsync that actually matches.

- You are at the tip of the iceberg on current Meta ads formats and visuals, and you keep up as the tools change.



-------------------------------------------

WHAT EVERY VIDEO YOU SHIP HAS



You build scroll stopping VSLs, 3 to 10 minutes long, that feel like content and not like an ad. Every video has:



- A hook in the first 3 seconds that stops the scroll, then a story and pacing that holds attention all the way to the offer.

- High quality effects and edits, done cleanly, never cheap or overdone.

- Strong scene selection. You know exactly which scenes to use for each part of the video and why, and what visual needs to be on screen at every 
nt to keep the customer watching.

- Hyper realistic AI b-roll and images, AI avatars, and AI voices with real emotion. No robotic voices, no fake-looking visuals.

- Clean, styled captions plus music and SFX that hit on the beats and lift the emotion.

- Delivered ready to upload in the placements we run (typically 9:16 and 4:5), with everything burned in.



-------------------------------------------

YOU UNDERSTAND THE CUSTOMER AND YOU HAVE TASTE



- Once you know our target customer, you build the whole video to resonate with exactly that person, without being told how. You pick the avatar, the voice, the visuals, and the tone that match who we are selling to. If we are targeting older men, you instinctively choose an avatar, voice, and style that lands with older men. If we are targeting young women, you choose differently. You get it right because you actually understand the customer.

- You know the difference between high quality visuals and bad AI slop, and you only ship the good stuff. You have real taste and you do not need me to tell you what looks good.



-------------------------------------------

TRAINING (REQUIRED FOR THIS ROLE)



You have real training and a background from Ecom Talent or a similar ecommerce Meta ads editing course or community. This role is for people who have already put in the reps to learn these specific skills.



-------------------------------------------

HOW FAST YOU NEED TO MOVE



This is high volume. We push out a lot of concepts, so you need to turn around full VSLs quickly and consistently, e.g. 10 to 20 videos per week, full VSL within 24 to 48 hours. Fast execution at a high standard is the whole job. If you are slow or you need a lot of revisions to get it right, this is not the role for you.



-------------------------------------------

PAY, BONUSES, AND GROWTH



- Pay starts at $6 per finished video and increases to $8 as you prove your quality and speed.

- If you are truly exceptional, one of the best at editing and creating these videos, I am willing to pay more. We will talk.

- Cash bonuses on top when an ad you made wins and scales.

- Full time, not part time, because of the volume needed.

- Pay is sent every 2 weeks for the first month, then weekly from month 2.

- After month 1, the best editor moves into a paid lead role building our SOPs and training a team of 5 to 10 editors, at significantly higher pay.



-------------------------------------------

DO NOT APPLY IF



- You are not an experienced direct response Meta ads editor.

- You are a general video editor or a beginner.

- You cannot prompt your own AI video, images, voices, and avatars to a high standard.

- Your English is not strong. You need to speak and understand English clearly. I am not going back and forth dealing with miscommunication.



-------------------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY (READ THIS CAREFULLY)



Do not send me a resume or a profile. I want to see your actual best work with proof that you made it.



Send your portfolio as one Google Doc (make sure commenter access is on) that shows and explains at least 5 of your best pieces in different styles. For example a voiceover b-roll VSL, a clay AI animation, a skeleton AI animation, a Pixar style AI animation, and an AI avatar ad, all for direct response Meta ads brands. Send what you personally believe is your best work, whether or not it was the best performing. I just want to see how good you actually are.



At the bottom of that same doc, add your single highest performing Meta ads edit that you made yourself, with the result if you have it.



Then send a 30 second Loom with your camera on, showing your face, telling me in clear English why I should hire you over everyone else, based on your specific skills.



First come first served, and I am onboarding within 24 to 40 hours, so send it fast.



Text me on WhatsApp at 
and start your message with the word CONVERT. Do NOT message me through OnlineJobs, there are too many messages there and yours will get lost.



My name is Xanth.

title: Collections Specialist
description:
Are you a highly organized, empathetic, and solutions-driven professional? 



Our Collections Department handles all billing and collections concerns, including but not limited to: Invoice disputes, Payment Plans, missed payments, and outstanding balances.



We are seeking a Remote Collections Specialist to join our dynamic Collections/Billing Team. 



In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for clients navigating billing inquiries, payment plans, and outstanding balances. You will act as a bridge between our clients and our legal team, ensuring that delinquent accounts are handled with professionalism, accuracy, and care.
