title: Bookkeeper — QuickBooks Online (Australian Tax & GST)
description:
Cleanup, Restructure & Ongoing Bookkeeping  ·  Remote (Philippines)

Long-term role with a family-run Queensland agribusiness



Engagement Part-time, long-term — around 15-20 hours/week once established (more during the initial cleanup)

Hours Flexible and deadline-based — we care that the work is done well and on time, not that you sit set hours each day

Software QuickBooks Online (we are staying on QuickBooks — this is a QBO role)

Reports to Business owner

Start As soon as we find the right person



About us

We are a family-run agribusiness in rural Queensland, Australia, running several enterprises under one roof. Our main business is a paddock-to-plate meat operation selling premium Wagyu and grass-fed beef direct to customers at markets and online. Alongside this we run cattle, produce hay, do contract farm work, and make a natural tallow-based skincare range. We need one reliable, long-term person to take ownership of our bookkeeping so we can focus on running the business.

The role

We have used QuickBooks for many years and have a lot of history in the file. We are staying on QuickBooks — we are NOT migrating to Xero. The first big job is a thorough cleanup and restructure of our existing QuickBooks Online file so that each of our enterprises reports clearly and our GST is correct. After that, you keep everything reconciled, accurately coded, and ready for our Business Activity Statements (BAS) and end-of-year tax.

Important: BAS and tax documents are prepared by you and reviewed/lodged by the owner. You prepare; we review and lodge.

What you will do

• Clean up and restructure our existing QuickBooks Online file — review the chart of accounts, remove duplicates, fix inconsistent coding, and set up a clean, consistent structure (you would confirm the proposed structure with us before making major changes).

• Set up each enterprise to report separately (meat, cattle, hay, contract work, skincare) using QuickBooks Classes (and Locations where helpful), so we can see income and expenses for each part of the business.

• Process and reconcile all bank and credit card transactions across multiple accounts.

• Handle Australian GST correctly. Most of our food/meat sales are GST-free, while many of our supplier purchases include GST that we can claim. You apply the right GST code to every transaction, and review and correct existing coding during the cleanup.

• Prepare Business Activity Statements (BAS) and supporting documents for the owner to review and lodge.

• Produce regular reports — profit & loss by enterprise, GST position, and cash position — so we can see how each part of the business is tracking.

• Flag any errors, unusual transactions, or anything without supporting documentation, rather than guessing. We value someone who asks and flags rather than assumes.

Must have

• Solid hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online — including cleaning up and restructuring an established file, not just data entry. (This is essential. Please only apply if you are genuinely experienced in QuickBooks Online.)

• Good understanding of Australian GST, including the difference between GST-free sales and GST-inclusive purchases, and BAS preparation.

• Experience using QuickBooks Classes (and Locations) for separating and reporting on different parts of a business.

• A bookkeeping or accounting qualification, with real experience keeping books for businesses.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy — this matters more to us than speed.

• Reliable, responsive, and able to work independently to deadlines. Good written English, reliable internet, and your own computer.

• Honesty and discretion handling confidential financial information.

Nice to have

• Experience with Australian clients and Australian BAS/tax.

• Experience with multi-enterprise, farming, or primary-production accounts.

• Payroll / STP experience.

Why work with us

• Long-term, stable role with room to grow your hours and responsibility.

• Real ownership of the books — you run the system, not just data entry.

• Flexible, deadline-based hours — we trust you to manage your own time and deliver.

How to apply

Applications that answer the questions below will be prioritised — it shows us you read the ad and helps us find the right person quickly. Please send:

1. Your CV / resume (pasted into your reply or attached through OnlineJobs.ph please — not a Google Drive link).

2. A short note on your QuickBooks Online experience — in particular, any file cleanups or restructures you’ve done.

3. Your experience with Australian GST and BAS.

4. Your hourly rate (in USD) and the hours per day you are available.

And please answer these three quick questions in your application:

• In QuickBooks Online, how would you set up the file so that income and expenses can be reported separately for several different parts of one business?

• If a sale is GST-free but the supplier invoice for that product included GST, how do you treat each side in the books?

• If you took over a messy QuickBooks file with duplicate accounts and inconsistent coding, how would you approach cleaning it up?

Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short paid test task before we make an offer.

title: Direct Response Copywriter & Creative Strategist in one role for 7-8 Figure supplement brand
description:
Summary

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are a fast-scaling direct-to-consumer health brand looking for an elite, data-backed Direct-Response Copywriter & Creative Strategist. We are looking for an angle-hunter, a script-master, and a conversion-mechanic rolled into one.



We do not write generic, corporate marketing copy, nor do we build standard e-commerce funnels. We create high-stakes, logically airtight, direct-to-consumer health campaigns.



If you are the type of writer who relies on basic adjectives, template formats, and surface-level benefits, please do not apply. But if you actively breathe Eugene Schwartz’s Breakthrough Advertising principles, know exactly how to manipulate Market Sophistication and Awareness levels, and execute the RMBC Method flawlessly under tight deadlines, this role is engineered for you.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

End-to-End Creative Strategy & Ideation: You won’t just take orders; you will lead the creative direction. You will deep-dive into market research, analyze ad comments and forums, review customer data, and dream up completely fresh visual hooks and positioning angles to scale our media buying spend.



Write Category-Defining VSLs (~3-5 Minutes): You will craft high-retention, problem-aware video scripts utilizing psychological pattern-interrupts and visceral, real-world analogies. You must be able to pitch a severe physical crisis and bridge it seamlessly to a proprietary solution without losing the user's logic or trust.



Draft Long-Form Hybrid PDPs: You will reverse-engineer standard, boring e-commerce checkout pages and convert them into long-form editorial landing pages that seamlessly function as high-converting checkout carts.



Write Native Advertorials: You will script top-of-funnel presell articles that systematically dismantle mainstream band-aids and open a massive curiosity loop that drives massive clicks to our main offers.



REQUIRED SKILLS & STRATEGIC KNOWLEDGE

Mastery of Market Awareness & Sophistication: You understand how to market to a highly saturated, highly skeptical consumer base. You know how to take a Problem-Aware prospect (someone experiencing real physical symptoms but clueless about the underlying biological cause) and bypass their defensive walls by targeting a hidden, external enemy.



The RMBC Method (Research, Mechanism, Brief, Copy): This is non-negotiable. You must deeply understand how to isolate a Unique Mechanism of the Problem (UMP) and a Unique Mechanism of the Solution (UMS) to form a bulletproof, logical chain.



Simplification of Complex Science: You know how to take advanced biological concepts and translate them into clear, simple, punchy, real-world analogies (e.g., explaining bodily pipelines using concepts like plumbing, traffic jams, collapsed highways, or rusted pipes).



Visual Storyboarding: You write copy with the video editor in mind. Every line of your script must explicitly dictate a clear, second-by-second visual action, b-roll directive, or high-contrast text overlay to maximize video hold-rates.



QUALIFICATIONS

3+ years of verifiable direct-response copywriting and creative strategy experience in the supplement, health, longevity, or financial publishing verticals.



A portfolio showcasing winning VSLs, long-form landing pages, or advertorials that have generated consistent, profitable ROAS on cold traffic platforms (Meta, Google, YouTube).



Direct study or formal training in ancestral direct-response frameworks (Breakthrough Advertising, Stefan Georgi’s RMBC framework, or classic Agora-style copywriting models).



High speed of execution. You can research a bodily mechanism deeply, map out a full creative strategy brief, and execute a clean first draft efficiently without endless corporate hand-holding.



WHAT WE OFFER

Profitable Scaling Environment: Our media buying team is world-class. Your winning hooks, scripts, angles, and landing pages will immediately be backed by substantial daily ad spend.



ROAS Bonuses: When your copy and creative strategy wins, you win. We offer direct performance bonuses tied to scaling the conversion rates and average order values (AOV) of your campaigns.



Complete Creative Autonomy: No slow, painful corporate committees. We move fast, split-test aggressively, and rely entirely on what the data dictates.



TO APPLY:

Please send over a brief introduction outlining your experience with the RMBC method, your background in managing Creative Strategy, and 2-3 links to live or past direct-response assets (VSLs, PDPs, Advertorials, or ad briefs) that showcase your ability to convert cold traffic.

title: Creative Strategist — DTC Supplement Brands (Full-Time)
description:
Summary

999 Supplements is the parent company behind a portfolio of fast-growing DTC supplement brands sold across the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. We build direct-response brands rooted in deep customer research, sharp positioning, and a relentless testing cadence on Meta. We're not a generalist e-commerce shop — every brand we run is engineered around a specific avatar, a specific angle, and a specific desire.



The role



We're looking for a Creative Strategist to own our winning-ad pipeline end to end. Your job is simple to describe and hard to do well: find what's working in the market, understand why it's working, and reverse-engineer it into ads that win for our brands.

You'll work directly with the founder and a team of video editors. You won't be cutting video yourself — you'll be the brain that d
 what gets made, for whom, and why.



What you'll actually do



Research the avatar, angle, and desire. For each brand, you'll go deep on who we're selling to, what stage of awareness they're in (Schwartz's awareness ladder is the operating system here), and what language they actually use to describe their problem — pulled from real voice-of-customer sources, not assumptions.

Hunt winning creatives. Daily/weekly sweeps of
 Ads Library across direct and indirect competitors, sorted by highest impressions. You'll know which ads are scaling, which mechanisms are getting traction, and which hooks keep showing up.

Transcribe and reverse-engineer. You'll pull scripts from winning competitor ads, feed them through our brief-writing process (with research docs, avatar docs, and product context as inputs), and produce briefs our editors can actually execute on.

Track everything. Every tested creative goes into our Growth Guide '25 spreadsheet. Every brief becomes a Notion card with proper naming conventions and brief links. You own this hygiene — if it's not tracked, it didn't happen.

Rinse and repeat. This is a volume game with a quality floor. Weekly briefs, weekly tests, weekly learnings, weekly iteration.

What we're looking for



2+ years writing direct-response briefs or scripts for DTC brands, ideally supplements, health, or beauty

Native-level fluency in Meta ad creative — you can watch a UGC ad and tell us in 30 seconds why it's working

Working knowledge of the awareness ladder, problem/solution/product awareness, and how to write for each stage

Comfortable with research-heavy workflows: scraping reviews, lurking in
 groups and forums, finding the exact phrase a customer uses before they know what's wrong with them

Organized. Notion, Google Sheets, and clean naming conventions are non-negotiable

Writes fast, writes clearly, takes feedback without ego

Bonus: experience with VSLs, advertorials, or presell pages



What you won't be doing



Posting to organic social

Designing graphics or editing video

Running the ad accounts (you'll work closely with the buyer, but media buying isn't your job)



How we work

Our workflow is: Research ? Data Analysis ? Hypothesis ? Copy ? Test ? Feedback Loop ? Repeat. Friday is our weekly performance audit. We run lean, we move fast, and we expect everyone on the team to bring a point of view.



How to apply

Send the following to our inbox/message:



- A short note on the best DTC ad you've seen this month and why it works (3–5 sentences, no fluff)

- A link or attachment of one brief or script you've written that produced results — include the metrics if you have them

- Short Loom video where you explain what creative strategy is and if you have experience. So you can explain everything here

- Your CV or portfolio



Applications without #1 and #2 and #3 won't be reviewed.

title: Lead Vendor Manager
description:
# Lead Vendor Manager



## Job Overview



We are looking for a strong, organized, and highly assertive **Lead Vendor Manager** to manage and grow our network of lead vendors. This person will be responsible for finding new vendors, onboarding them into our system, making sure they understand our rules, managing day-to-day vendor communication, handling disputes, tracking performance, and coordinating vendor payments.



This role is not for someone passive. We need someone who can build relationships but also hold vendors accountable, enforce standards, and protect the company from bad traffic, poor-quality leads, compliance issues, and unnecessary payment disputes.



The ideal candidate is confident, direct, detail-oriented, and comfortable dealing with high-volume vendor communication.



## Key Responsibilities



### Vendor Recruiting & Relationship Building



* Actively search for and solicit new lead vendors.

* Build relationships with vendors who can generate qualified insurance leads or transferred calls.

* Explain our program, qualification standards, payment structure, and compliance rules.

* Maintain a pipeline of potential vendors and follow up consistently.

* Help evaluate whether new vendors are a good fit before they are approved.



### Vendor Onboarding



* Guide new vendors through the onboarding process.

* Make sure vendors are set up correctly in our vendor system.

* Train vendors on call requirements, lead qualifications, transfer expectations, hours of operation, and compliance rules.

* Confirm that vendors understand what is billable and non-billable before they begin sending traffic.

* Work with internal tea
mbers to make sure vendor setup, tracking, and reporting are accurate.



### Vendor Performance Management



* Monitor vendor lead/call quality.

* Track vendor volume, conversion quality, disputes, rejected leads, and payment trends.

* Identify vendors who are sending low-quality traffic or failing to follow instructions.

* Communicate clearly with vendors when performance needs to improve.

* Recommend pausing, reducing, or terminating vendor relationships when needed.



### Dispute Management



* Handle vendor disputes professionally and firmly.

* Review disputed calls/leads against company rules and qualification standards.

* Communicate payment decisions clearly to vendors.

* Keep organized records of disputes, approvals, rejections, and final outcomes.

* Protect the company from paying for unqualified or non-compliant leads.



### Vendor Payments



* Prepare and review vendor payment reports.

* Confirm billable leads/calls before payment is issued.

* Coordinate weekly vendor payouts.

* Track payment history and resolve payment-related questions.

* Make sure vendors are paid accurately and on time when they meet requirements.



### Compliance & Quality Control



* Ensure vendors follow company guidelines, including DNC requirements, transfer rules, scripting expectations, and call quality standards.

* Watch for red flags such as misrepresentation, poor-quality transfers, recycled leads, non-qualified prospects, or compliance violations.

* Escalate serious vendor issues quickly.

* Maintain clean documentation around vendor rules, disputes, and performance.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal person for this role is:



* Assertive and confident

* Comfortable having difficult conversations

* Not easily pushed around by vendors

* Organized and detail-oriented

* Strong at follow-up

* Able to balance relationship-building with accountability

* Comfortable enforcing rules and saying “no”

* Fast-moving and proactive

* Good with systems, spreadsheets, CRM tools, and reporting

* Able to manage multiple vendors at once without losing track of details



## Required Skills & Experience



* Experience managing vendors, lead providers, affiliates, call centers, or marketing partners preferred

* Experience in insurance, pay-per-call, lead generation, sales, or performance marketing is a strong plus

* Strong written and verbal communication skills

* Strong negotiation and conflict-resolution skills

* Ability to review data, reports, calls, and dispute records

* High attention to detail

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced sales environment

* Ability to enforce rules without damaging productive relationships

* Reliable, accountable, and self-managed



## Personality Fit



This role requires someone with a strong personality. You must be able to push back when vendors are wrong, challenge questionable traffic, and enforce standards without needing constant direction.



We want someone who is professional and respectful, but also firm, direct, and not afraid of confrontation when necessary.



## Success in This Role Looks Like



* New vendors are consistently being recruited and onboarded.

* Vendors clearly understand our expectations before sending traffic.

* Disputes are handled quickly and fairly.

* Payments are accurate and organized.

* Bad vendors are identified and addressed quickly.

* Good vendors are supported and encouraged to scale.

* Internal teams have fewer vendor-related issues.

* Lead/call quality improves over time.



## Compensation



Compensation will depend on experience and role structure. This may include a base salary or hourly pay, with potential performance bonuses based on vendor growth, quality, and volume.



## How to Apply



Please apply with your resume and a short note explaining your experience managing vendors, affiliates, lead sources, call centers, or similar relationships.



Bonus points if you have experience in insurance, lead generation, pay-per-call, or performance marketing.

title: Sales Manager
description:
Accuwise is a fast-growing online CPA firm providing accounting, bookkeeping, tax, payroll, and advisory services to small businesses throughout the United States.



Our mission is to help business owners understand their numbers, improve profitability, reduce taxes, and achieve long-term financial success.



As we continue to expand, we are seeking experienced Sales Managers to join our team and help drive growth in assigned territories.



Position Overview

This is a hunter role for experienced sales professionals who enjoy building relationships, generating opportunities, and closing new business.



Each Sales Manager is assigned an exclusive territory and is responsible for managing the complete sales cycle, including prospecting, appointment setting, consultations, follow-up, and closing new clients.

Accuwise provides comprehensive marketing support, brand development, CRM systems, technology platforms, and operational support. Sales Managers are expected to take ownership of their territory and consistently develop new business opportunities.



Responsibilities

• Prospect and develop new business opportunities within assigned territory.

• Conduct outbound calls,
s, and follow-up campaigns.

• Schedule and conduct virtual consultations with business owners.

• Manage the entire sales process from prospecting through closing.

• Maintain accurate CRM records and sales activities.

• Meet or exceed monthly sales goals.

• Represent Accuwise professionally at all times.

• Collaborate with management to improve sales performance and client acquisition.



Qualifications

• Minimum 6 years of successful sales experience.

• Proven track record of prospecting and closing new business.

• Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.

• Comfortable conducting virtual sales meetings.

• Experience using CRM systems.

• Highly organized and self-motivated.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment.



Preferred Experience:

• Professional Services

• Financial Services

• Payroll Services

• Insurance

• SaaS

• Business Consulting

• B2B Sales



Compensation & Benefits

Accuwise offers a performance-based compensation plan designed to reward production and long-term success.



Compensation includes:

• Weekly base salary with opportunities for permanent increases based on performance.

• Uncapped commission opportunities.

• Monthly performance bonuses.

• Exclusive territory assignment.

• Career advancement opportunities.



Earnings Potential

Typical Sales Managers can expect to earn:

• $1,000 – $2,500+ per month during their first several months.

Top-performing Sales Managers can earn:

• $3,000 – $5,000+ per month.



Exceptional performers who consistently exceed goals may earn substantially more through commissions, bonuses, and advancement opportunities.



What We Provide

• Established and growing brand.

• Professional website and marketing materials.

• CRM and sales technology platform.

• Marketing support and brand recognition.

• Administrative and operational support.

• Service delivery team to fulfill client engagements.

• Leadership and growth opportunities.



References Required

Qualified applicants must provide:

• Three professional references.

• Two former supervisors or managers.

• Verification of prior sales experience and performance upon request.



Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for hunters, not order takers.

The ideal candidate is comfortable prospecting, building relationships, conducting consultations, overcoming objections, and closing new business independently.

If you have a strong work ethic, enjoy selling, and want an opportunity with significant earning potential and long-term growth, we encourage you to apply.



Job Type: Full-Time Remote

Experience Required: 6+ Years Sales Experience

Openings Available: Multiple Positions

We use AutoHDR for our photo editing. Sometimes the program makes mistakes and we need someone with a good eye and attention to detail to make those fixes before sending to the client.

We have a separate video editing vendor in Vietnam, you would review the videos and provide any feedback and fixes to our video editing team or be able to make simple fixes yourself.

- Edit and enhance real estate photos (straightening slanted/horizontal lines, exposure, white balance, composition improvements, lens correction, etc.).

- Use AutoHDR and/or Lightroom for photo editing and fixes.

- Deliver completed media packages through Aryeo to clients.

- Maintain consistent brand standards and meet tight deadlines.



Requirements

- Proven experience editing real estate photos with a strong eye for composition, lighting, and fixing slanted/horizontal images.

- Experience delivering media through Aryeo.

- Comfortable using (or quick to learn) AutoHDR for photo enhancement.

- Proficient in Final Cut Pro for basic video fixes and QC.

- Excellent English communication skills (written and spoken).

- High-speed, stable internet connection with reliable power backup (no frequent outages) — this is critical as tasks are urgent and time-sensitive.

- Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently.



Big advantage if you have:

• Previous experience working with North American or Canadian real estate media companies.

• Fast turnaround and strong attention to detail under deadline pressure.



What We Offer:

• Competitive hourly rate with long-term opportunity with a growing company.

• Clear training, SOPs, and Loom videos for our exact workflow.

- experience related to this position

Your availability working during the day in your time zone. Our timezone is Toronto
 Time and it would be preferred that while it is our night that you are working with our video editing vendor in Vietnam and preparing photos to send to clients during the day in Philippine or similar time zone.

title: Meta Ads Creative Strategist
description:
Job Overview

We are a fast-growing Shopify direct-to-consumer (DTC) sleep technology brand, and we are looking for a highly analytical, sharp, and proactive Creative Strategist for Meta Ads.



To be incredibly clear: This is NOT a graphic design or video editing role. You will not be pushing pixels in Figma or editing timelines in Premiere.



You are the architect of our ad account. Your job is to conduct deep market research, understand consumer psychology, develop high-converting direct response (DR) angles, and write airtight creative briefs for our design and editing teams. You must understand why people buy and know how to structure a scroll-stopping hook and a persuasive script that sells.



If you are someone who waits to be handed a list of ideas to brief, or if you just guess what might look "cool" without looking at the data, this is not the role for you. We need a strategic powerhouse who owns the creative testing roadmap from insight to execution to analysis.



Core Responsibilities

- Deep Avatar & Market Research: Obsessively research our target demographic. You will scour competitor ad libraries, mine customer reviews, read Reddit threads, and analyze TikTok comments to uncover hidden pain points and desires.  

- Angle & Concept Ideation: Develop original, direct response advertising angles. You will translate your research into structured concepts (e.g., problem/solution, Us vs. Them, scientific proof/temperature control comparisons, emotional triggers). 

- Airtight Creative Briefing: Write highly detailed, idiot-proof creative briefs and video scripts for our designers and editors. Your briefs must clearly define the hook, the visual layout, the on-screen text, the pacing, and the core CTA.  

- Creative Performance Analysis: You won't just launch briefs and forget them. You will actively analyze performance data in Meta Ads Manager and our attribution software (e.g., Northbeam, Triple Whale) to diagnose hook rates, thumb-stop ratios, and CPA. You must be able to explain why an ad won or lost.  

- Testing Roadmap Management: Build and manage our weekly creative testing pipeline, ensuring a consistent flow of fresh concepts, iterative variations of winning ads, and new format tests.  



Required Qualifications & Skills

- Direct Response Mastery is Mandatory: You must have a deep, proven understanding of what makes a Meta ad convert. You know the anatomy of a winning ad, consumer psychology, and how to structure a pitch that drives immediate action.

- Exceptional Copywriting & Scripting: Flawless written English. You must be able to write punchy, persuasive video scripts, ad copy, and headlines that resonate with a US-based consumer.

- Data Literacy: You must be comfortable reading data. You know the difference between a creative problem (low hook rate) and a landing page problem (high CTR, low CVR), and you use that data to guide your next brief.

- Proactive & Independent: You do not need to be micromanaged. You independently spot fatigue in our ad account, research what competitors are scaling, and pitch your own concepts.

- Reliable Setup: High-speed internet connection (with a backup plan) and a reliable computer.



Nice-to-Haves (Not Mandatory)

- Prior experience strategizing for sleep-tech, health/wellness, or high-AOV premium home goods brands.

- Familiarity with creative research and saving tools like Foreplay or Atria.



How to Apply:

- A link to a portfolio or Google Drive folder containing 2–3 examples of creative briefs or scripts you have written that resulted in profitable ads, and the images/videos of those ads (if available).

title: Media Buying
description:
Senior Media Buyer (Meta & Google Ads Specialist)



PAYMENT IS SALARY + PERFORMANCE!!



About the Role:

We are looking for an elite Media Buyer who understands that the landscape of paid acquisition has fundamentally changed. We don’t need someone who just pushes buttons or relies on outdated targeting hacks. We need a strategic operator who understands that on Meta, creative is the new targeting, and on Google, profitability (ROAS) and market dominance are the ultimate metrics.

If you understand the implications of Meta’s Andromeda retrieval system and know how to systematically scale Google Ads from proof-of-concept to aggressive growth, we want you on our team.

What You Will Do:



Meta Ads (Post-Andromeda Strategy):

Manage and scale Meta campaigns using Advantage+ Shopping Campaigns (ASC) and broad targeting structures.

Implement creative-led scaling. You know that finding a "winning ad" isn't enough; you must continuously feed the machine with conceptually distinct creatives (varying angles, formats, and personas) to avoid Entity ID overlap and creative fatigue.

Manage budget allocation based on the
rule (proven winners, variations, fresh concepts).

Diagnose stalled delivery by analyzing hook rates, hold rates, frequency, and signal quality, rather than just tweaking ad set targeting.



Google Ads (Performance & Scaling):

Build and optimize Google Search and Performance Max (PMax) campaigns with a strict focus on profitability and total revenue.

Execute systematic keyword research (finding the 2-4 word "sweet spot") and ensure tight ad relevance and landing page alignment.

Transition campaigns from Max Conversions/Manual CPC to tROAS/tCPA once proof of concept is established.

Manage aggressive scaling strategies, monitoring key market dominance metrics like Search Impression Share, Absolute Top %, and Click Share.

Maintain data integrity by properly segmenting branded vs. non-branded traffic and ensuring accurate tracking across the funnel.



Who You Are:

Deeply Analytical & Creative: You understand that media buying is now a blend of data analysis and creative strategy. You can brief creative teams based on performance data and psychological triggers/barriers.



Systematic & Disciplined: You don't make emotional changes to campaigns. You respect learning phases (minimum 50-75 conversions on Meta) and scale budgets systematically (e.g., 20-30% bumps on Google).



A Continuous Learner: You stay up-to-date with the bleeding edge of ad tech. You know why interest stacking is dead on Meta and how to properly structure a PMax campaign without cannibalizing search.



Fluent in the Metrics that Matter: You look past vanity metrics. You speak the language of MER (Marketing Efficiency Ratio), Thumbstop Ratio, and true CPA.



Requirements:

Proven track record of managing profitable Meta and Google Ads campaigns (portfolio/case studies required).

Deep understanding of Meta's current retrieval engine (Andromeda) and Google's automated bidding strategies.

Experience with tracking and attribution tools (e.g., Triple Whale, Northbeam, GA4, Server-Side Tracking).

Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.



To Apply:

Please include the phrase "Creative is Targeting" at the top of your application so we know you read this description. Along with your resume, please provide a brief summary of a time you successfully scaled a campaign using a creative-led strategy on Meta or a structured scaling approach on Google.

title: AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property-tech, remote)
description:
Title:

AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property-tech, remote)



Role

We are looking for a strong, reliable engineer who likes to move fast with AI tools and still ships carefully. We care heavily about clear communication, good decisions, and a clean trial result.



About us

We are a European property-tech company. We maintain a long-running Laravel application with Blade, Vue 2, Bootstrap, and tenant-scoped data patterns. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes.



How we work

We use an AI-assisted development workflow. You are expected to use coding assistants to speed up analysis and implementation, but you treat generated output as draft work: clarify scope, plan the change, verify behaviour, keep diffs small, and prove changes with sensible and thorough checks and testing before review.



This role is a great fit if you like turning requirements into a short plan, using AI where it helps, keeping changes easy to review, and checking your work before you ask for feedback. It is not a fit if you want to ship large unreviewed blocks of AI-generated code.



What you will do

- Deliver scoped changes on a mature Laravel + Vue 2 codebase using AI-assisted methods safely.

- Open merge requests with clear descriptions, scoped commits, and tests where applicable.

- Communicate in writing about plan, trade-offs, and verification steps.



Requirements

- Demonstrable AI-assisted workflow in real product work (you can explain it concretely).

- Comfortable working in Laravel in a larger codebase, including reading and navigating existing code you did not write yourself.

- Comfortable with Vue 2 in production, or strong Vue experience with a clear plan to work within Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- Comfortable with Blade templates and web security (escaping, CSRF, safe handling of user input).

- Solid Git habits: branches, scoped commits, merge request workflow.

- Written English strong enough for async work with EU stakeholders.

- Ideally 4 to 6 hours overlap per workday with CET business hours (Monday to Friday). Please state your timezone and the CET window you can reliably cover each workday.



Nice to have

- AI-assisted work on legacy codebases (careful refactors, incremental upgrades, tenant-scoped features).

- Laravel Mix / Webpack and Docker-based local builds.

- Multi-tenant SaaS experience.



Trial (before any production access)

We run a mini-trial on a sandbox repository that mirrors our stack patterns but contains no production code or customer data. Timebox is about 4 to 6 hours, agreed upfront.



You may use AI tools during the trial, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you submit.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Your current AI-assisted workflow: how you scope prompts, verify output, and prevent scope creep.

2) One example where an AI tool gave a wrong or risky suggestion. How did you catch it?

3) Either (A) walk us through one concrete merge request or commit you authored where AI was your primary tool: what you prompted, what came back, and what you changed before merge, or (B) if you cannot share a link, describe your first 30 minutes on an unfamiliar legacy Laravel/Vue task before you edit code.

4) How do you keep AI-assisted changes small and reviewable in a legacy monolith?

5) Multi-tenant safety: what checks would you do before changing a query that returns tenant-owned records?

6) What information must never be pasted into external AI tools? Name categories, not examples from real projects.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work.

- You ship AI output without verification.

- You cannot describe your workflow concretely.

- You only have Vue 3 experience and cannot commit to Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools.

title: Ecommerce DTC Video Editor
description:
We're a growing direct-to-consumer ecommerce brand running paid social campaigns across multiple international markets (Australia, New Zealand, Canada, the UK, and the US). We're looking for a fast, sharp video editor to turn scripts and footage into scroll-stopping ads for
 and Instagram.



This is a direct-response role, not a brand-film role. We care about hooks that stop the scroll, pacing that holds attention, and edits that drive clicks and sales. If you understand what makes a paid social ad actually convert, you'll do well here.



What you'll be responsible for:



Editing both short-form ads (hook-driven, fast-paced) and long-form ads (VSL-style, testimonial, story-led) for Meta

Cutting strong, punchy hooks in the first three seconds to maximise hook rate

Pacing edits to hold attention all the way through (retention is everything)

Sourcing your own footage and content when needed (stock, UGC-style, b-roll) as well as editing from provided footage and assets

Producing multiple hook variations of the same ad for testing

Adding captions, text overlays, b-roll, sound design, and music that lift the ad

Using AI video and content tools to create and enhance assets where it speeds up or strengthens the work

Turning around revisions quickly and cleanly

Keeping a tidy, organised file and project structure so assets are easy to find and reuse

Working from voiceover and supplied creative direction to match the intended tone



What I expect from you:



Strong grasp of both short-form AND long-form direct-response editing for paid social

An instinct for hooks, pacing, and retention

Resourceful: able to find and source the right content yourself, not just wait for footage to be handed to you

Confident across all major editing software (see below), and able to work in whatever the job calls for

Confident across AI video and content tools (see below), and quick to pick up new ones as they emerge

Fast turnaround without dropping quality

Clean, accurate captioning and attention to detail

Reliable and self-managing: you hit deadlines without being chased

Open to feedback and quick to apply revisions fully



Editing software you should know:



CapCut

Premiere Pro

After Effects

Plus any other editing software you work in (tell me which)



AI tools you should know (or learn fast):



HeyGen

Higgsfield

ElevenLabs (voiceover)

Plus any other AI video, image, and content generation tools you've worked with (tell me which)



Nice to have:



Experience editing ecommerce or DTC paid social ads with proven results

Familiarity with what makes Meta ads convert (hook rate, hold rate, retention)

Motion graphics and sound design skills



Communication:



Day-to-day communication with me and the team happens through Slack and WhatsApp, so you'll need to be responsive and reachable on both during your working hours.



Tools you'll use:



Editing software (CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects, and others)

AI tools (HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, and others)

Slack and WhatsApp

Shared drives for footage and assets



Please start application with answer of 11 + 11



How to apply



Send me a short intro, a link to your portfolio or 2 to 3 examples of short-form AND long-form ads you've edited, and your WhatsApp number so I can reach you. If you've edited paid social ads before, tell me what results they got. List the editing software and AI tools you've used.

title: AI Video + VFX  Needed for Premium Brand Videos
description:
Comment to "Type of Employment: Any": This starts as one Gig, but can turn into a long Full-Time job.



Now to the 

JOB DESCRIPTION:



Project: one video (Short Clip about 1 minute)

One will need AI and VFX skills. 



We are looking for a highly capable video creator or a small production team for CruiseLife brand videos.

These are not simple Canva videos, not slideshow videos, and not stock-footage-only projects. We need someone who can realistically judge what is possible with AI video, VFX, animation, stock material, and real filming — and then produce a professional final result.

You may apply for VFX-video, but please be very clear about what you can actually deliver.

________________________________________

Project 1: “The CruiseLife WAVE”

This video requires a cinematic beach scene where a wave transforms into the CruiseLife wordmark.

The key visual idea:

A bright, sunny, elegant beach scene. A wave rolls toward the viewer. The water gradually forms abstract shapes, then hints of upside-down letters, then rotates into upright letters, and finally, the word CruiseLife lands deeply in the wet sand as a large 3D wordmark.

This project requires:

• Strong VFX / animation capability 

• Water simulation or convincing AI/VFX water effects 

• 3D text/wordmark integration 

• Realistic interaction between wave, sand, splash, droplets, and letters 

• Ability to follow a detailed storyboard 

• Ability to avoid side-view mistakes, mirrored letters, or generic wave footage 

• Final output suitable for brand marketing 

Important:

This project previously failed because the freelancer could edit video but could not deliver the required VFX. Please do not apply for this project unless you can show real examples of comparable VFX, water effects, 3D text integration, or advanced AI/VFX work.



What We Need From You

Please apply only if you can provide:

• A realistic production plan 

• Honest assessment of what can be done with AI, VFX and stock footage.

• Strong English communication 

• Ability to work from a detailed storyboard/script 

• Regular progress updates 

• Short preview clips before final rendering 

• Clean final export in high quality 

• Commercial usage rights for all footage, music, voice, AI output, and edited material 

________________________________________

Required Application Details

Please answer these questions in your application:

1. Which tools do you use? Example: Runway, Kling, Veo, Midjourney, After Effects, Blender, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, etc. 

2. For Video 1: Can you create realistic VFX involving waves, water, sand, splash, and 3D text? Please show examples. 

3. Please send 3–5 examples of your best relevant work. 

4. What exactly did you personally do in those examples? 

5. Are you comfortable working from a very detailed storyboard and following exact visual instructions? 

6. What would be your recommended workflow for this type of project? 

7. What is your estimated price range for a 30–60 second video of this quality? 

8. How many revisions are included? 

________________________________________

Important Quality Requirement

We are not looking for someone who simply says, “Yes, I can do it.”

We are looking for someone who can say:

• “This part is possible with AI.” 

• “This part needs VFX.” 

• “This part should be filmed.” 

• “This part is risky.” 

• “This is the best workflow.” 

• “Here is a small test before we continue.” 

Honesty and technical judgment are more important than overpromising.

________________________________________

First Step / Test

Before awarding the full project, we may request a short paid test scene.

This could be a 5–10 second sample showing wave / water / 3D wordmark integration.

________________________________________

Please Do Not Apply If

• You only create basic AI videos without editing skill 

• You only use stock footage 

• You cannot do or coordinate VFX 

• You cannot follow a detailed storyboard 

• You cannot communicate clearly in English 

• You cannot show relevant examples 

• You are not comfortable doing a small test first 

________________________________________

Final Deliverables

Final deliverables should include:

• Final video file in high quality 

• Version suitable for website / social media 

• Project files if agreed 

• Source assets where legally possible 

• Confirmation that all materials are cleared for commercial use

title: E-commerce/DTC Video Editor - For Ads (Full Time)
description:
Performance-focused · AI-augmented · Long-term



We run paid media at scale for DTC and e-commerce brands across European markets — and we're looking for an editor who gets the why behind every cut, not just the how.



This isn't a role for someone who waits for a brief and assembles clips. We need someone who can watch raw footage and know instinctively which B-roll makes the hook land — who understands that the wrong cutaway kills a conversion and the right one doubles watch time. If you've ever paused an ad you liked just to reverse-engineer why it worked, keep reading.



The basics





Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

Compensation: 900–1,100 USD/month

Start: ASAP

Output: 3–4 finished edits per day





What you'll own





Edit short-form ad creative for Meta and TikTok — fast, punchy, conversion-oriented

Choose and sequence B-roll with intent — every clip serves the hook, reinforces the claim, or deepens the emotional pull

Build visual hooks that stop the scroll — you know the first 1–2 seconds are the entire game

Cut UGC, founder, and testimonial footage into structured formats (Hook ? Problem ? Mechanism ? CTA)

Generate AI video assets in Higgsfield and similar tools — realistic, on-brand footage that blends seamlessly with real clips

Produce modular assets that repurpose cleanly across placements and audiences





Non-negotiables



Proven DTC/e-commerce ad editing. You've edited ads that actually ran on Meta or TikTok for real brands. You understand pacing curves, attention drop-off, and how to build an edit around a conversion goal — not just aesthetics.



Intentional B-roll selection. You don't fill gaps, you amplify the script. You know when a reaction shot beats a product shot, and when on-screen text does more work than either.



Visual hook creation. You think visually first. You can concept and execute an opening that creates immediate pattern interruption — without leaning on the script to carry it.



Higgsfield + AI fluency. You're already comfortable prompting and generating realistic AI video, and you know how to make Higgsfield output that doesn't read as AI. We provide advanced internal training — but you need a real foundation to build on.



Strong English comprehension. Most scripts and voiceovers are in English. You need to catch nuance, not just words, so your edit rhythm matches what's being said and why.



Comfortable in Notion. We run briefs, trackers, and feedback through Notion. You don't need to be a power user, but you need to work inside it day to day without friction.



Nice to have





VSL or long-form ad formats for cold traffic

Direct response frameworks (AIDA, PAS, and similar)

Other AI video tools beyond Higgsfield (Kling, Runway, Pika)

Working knowledge of Meta ad structure — formats, ratios, placements





Who fits here





You think like a marketer, not just a creative — you care about what converts

You bring ideas and push back on a brief when you see a better angle

You ship final-ready work, not "almost there"

Fast iteration energizes you; it doesn't slow you down

You're driven and you work hard — you take pride in output and don't need to be chased

You want to be part of a team, not a solo freelancer — you communicate, share wins, and lift the people around you

You're honest and loyal — we'd rather hear the hard truth early than a polished excuse late, and we build long-term with people who do the same





What we offer



This is a long-term seat, not a gig. We invest in the people who commit to us:





Access to a premium AI tool stack — HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, and more, all on us, so you're never limited by what you can produce

Advanced internal training on our editing systems, AI workflows, and direct response frameworks — you'll get better at this here than almost anywhere else

A real growth path — clear room to take on more ownership, scope, and responsibility as you prove yourself

A team that values honesty and loyalty — we're direct with each other, we back the people who back us, and we keep the people who grow with us





How to apply



Read this part carefully — applications without a portfolio won't be reviewed.





Portfolio. Link 3–5 ad edits you're proud of. DTC/e-commerce strongly preferred. If something ran and performed, tell us the result.

Your workflow. Walk us through how you go from brief to final cut. What do you ask for? What do you need? How do you handle unclear direction?

Your AI work. Include at least one example where you generated or integrated AI video. Higgsfield examples are a bonus.

Logistics. Your availability and timezone.





The trial task



This role comes with a paid-style trial task — and it's where you really win it. If you're hungry for this, don't wait to be asked: complete it, edit the result, and send it in with your application.



Trial task: 
/p/drippl/Video-Editor-Trial-Task-341f520455d9802bab7ae1594d83abe4?source=copy_link



If the edit is strong, we'll hire you on the spot. This is your chance to show us — not tell us — that you're the editor we're describing.

title: Landing Page Specialist
description:
Landing Page Specialist (CRO-Focused)



SALARY + PERFORMANCE BASED 



About the Role:

We are looking for a Landing Page Specialist who understands that a landing page is not a brochure — it is a conversion system. Your job is to close the gap between ad click and purchase (or lead). You will own the design, copy, and continuous optimization of every landing page we run traffic to across Meta and Google campaigns.

If you think a "good-looking" page is the goal, this is not the role for you. If you obsess over above-the-fold messaging, page speed, and why a visitor didn't convert, keep reading.

What You Will Do:

Design, build, and iterate high-converting landing pages for paid traffic (Meta, Google) across product pages, advertorials, lead gen pages, and VSLs.

Ensure every page is tightly aligned to the ad that sent the visitor there — matching the hook, the angle, and the offer. Message match is non-negotiable.

Write or closely collaborate on conversion copy: headlines, subheads, benefit stacks, objection handling, social proof, and CTAs.

Run structured A/B and multivariate tests with clear hypotheses, proper statistical significance thresholds, and documented learnings.

Optimize for page speed and Core Web Vitals, as both directly affect Quality Score on Google and conversion rates across all channels.

Analyze heatmaps, session recordings, and funnel drop-off data (Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or equivalent) to identify friction points and prioritize fixes.

Build landing page variants tailored to different funnel stages — top-of-funnel prospecting traffic requires a fundamentally different page than bottom-of-funnel retargeting traffic.

Who You Are:

Copy-First Thinker: You understand that design serves copy, not the other way around. You know that the headline is responsible for the majority of conversion outcomes and you treat it accordingly.

Analytically Rigorous: You do not declare a test a winner based on gut feel or small sample sizes. You understand statistical significance and know when to call a test and when to let it run.

Platform-Proficient: You are hands-on with at least one major page builder (Replo, GemPages, Pagefly, Unbounce, or Webflow) and can move fast without sacrificing quality.

Funnel-Aware: You understand how the landing page fits into the broader acquisition funnel. You know what a Media Buyer needs from you and you can translate ad creative angles into page structure.

Speed-Obsessed: You know that a 1-second delay in page load time can meaningfully reduce conversions and you treat performance optimization as a core responsibility, not an afterthought.

Requirements:

Portfolio of landing pages with documented conversion rate improvements (before/after data required — no portfolio without performance data will be considered).

Proficiency in at least one page builder platform (Replo, GemPages, Pagefly, Unbounce, Webflow, or similar).

Working knowledge of CRO principles: above-the-fold optimization, trust signals, social proof hierarchy, urgency/scarcity mechanics, and offer framing.

Familiarity with heatmap and session recording tools (Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or equivalent).

Basic understanding of how Google Ads Quality Score and Meta ad relevance diagnostics are affected by landing page experience.

Excellent written English — you will be writing or editing copy directly.

To Apply:

Please include the phrase "Message Match First" at the top of your application. Along with your resume, attach or link to 2–3 landing pages you have built, and for each one, include the conversion rate before and after your involvement. Applications without performance data will not be reviewed.

 us, make the very first line of your message the single word VELOCITY — on its own line.



What You'll Do

— Source profitable OA/RA leads daily using SAS and Keepa.

— Deliver all found, organized leads in our 
/ Database Website with sourcing links and your analysis on each profitable lead found.

— Experience with InventoryLab and Sellerboard (or comparable P&L tools)

— Exposure to Walmart Marketplace policies and the ability to transfer Amazon best practices to Walmart (we welcome Walmart leads as we sell there too)



Employee Benefits:

— Quarterly performance bonuses for meeting team goals

— Competitive pay compared to other employers

— Philippine national holidays honored

— Supportive, process-driven team with tools, SOPs, and coaching to help you win

— Growth path inside a fast-moving, seven-figure operation



ATTN BELOW ATTN BELOW ATTN BELOW



HOW TO APPLY, READ EVERY WORD:

The single most important trait of a great researcher is attention to detail. So our application is the first test. Applications that skip or miss any instruction below will not be reviewed— no exceptions. This is deliberate. If you can't follow our application instructions, you can't follow our sourcing SOPs.



There are three stages:



STAGE 1 is Application
 (Screening)

Send an
 with your resume attached and complete all of the following exactly:

1. Subject line, use this exact format: OA RESEARCHER – [YOUR FULL NAME] – [YOUR FAVORITE FOOD]

2. First line of your
 body must be the code word we hid earlier in this listing, on its own line at the very top. We won't tell you where it is— careful readers will have already found it.

3. A brief introduction. Sell yourself. Tell us about your real, profitable OA/RA experience and what you've personally sourced.

4. Reference one specific line from this listing that resonated with you, and explain why in one or two sentences.



5. Answer the sourcing math problem below. Show your work on a piece of paper and attach it to your application. Do not just give the final number:

A product sells for $29.99 on Amazon. Your unit cost is $14.50. Amazon's referral fee is 15% of the sale price, and the FBA fulfillment fee is $5.45 per unit.

(a) What is your net profit per unit?

(b) What is your ROI %?

(c) Would you source this product? At what minimum ROI and/or minimum profit do you personally pull the trigger, and why?



6. Confirm your availability for the preferred 6AM to 2PM PH overlap, or propose your hours.

— To prove you read this far: end your
 with the exact phrase "Leads ready by morning." Applications missing this phrase are auto-declined.



STAGE 2 is Keepa & OA Knowledge Test (No Interview Yet)

If your application is clean, we'll send you a short written test (answered in your own words, no copy-paste from Google or AI). that looks like this:

— On a Keepa chart, what does a drop (downward spike) in the Sales Rank line indicate? How would you use the "Sales Rank Drops – Last 30 / 90 days" figures to estimate monthly sales velocity?

— How do you use Keepa to determine how often Amazon itself is on a listing, and why does that change your buying decision?

— A listing shows a current Buy Box of $24.99, but Keepa shows the Buy Box bouncing between $18–$25 over 90 days. What does that pattern tell you, and would you still buy? Defend your answer.

— Walk us through every check you run on a lead before you submit it to us (in order).



We grade on accuracy and reasoning, not length. Fakers get filtered here.



STAGE 3 is the Zoom Interview

Only candidates who pass Stages 1 and 2 are invited to a Zoom interview with the team. Reliable video/voice required.



Timeline: We review applications within 1–3 business days. We move fast on strong candidates and we don't waste good people's time. If you've read this whole listing, followed every instruction, and you genuinely know your numbers: we want to hear from you.

title: Short-Form TikTok Editor (Spark Creator)
description:
SALARY: PHP 90,000–120,000/month (~$1,600–$2,100 USD) — with performance bonuses and raises as you prove out.



Hours: Full-time, structured daily schedule







Read this part first - 



Most editing jobs on here are churn-and-burn: vague briefs, no system, a client who disappears, and you're treated as disposable. This is the opposite. I'm building a small, elite team around a paid TikTok ad operation that's already working. I run on documented systems, clear SOPs, and clean structure. I pay top-of-market because I'm hiring one person for this seat and I want the best editor sitting in it, long-term.



If you're genuinely elite at native, organic-style TikTok editing — the kind that looks like a real person filmed it, not a brand ad — and you want a stable seat where there's a real path to grow with the company: keep reading.









The mission -



We produce high-volume, native-style TikTok content we call Sparks — short videos engineered to stop the scroll and pull a real reaction in the first second. Not corporate. Not YouTube-style. Not polished brand ads. Raw, fast, native-to-the-FYP content that looks organic and converts.



You'll work from briefs, hooks, references, and a documented Spark SOP. You're not inventing 50 videos from scratch — you're running a proven creative system at speed: core builds, hook swaps, variations, recuts. The system is mapped. Your job is to execute it at elite quality and volume, every single day, and to make each Spark feel native and alive.







What you'll do -



• Produce 30–50 Sparks/day off our documented system — core builds plus rapid variations (new hooks, new openers, recuts)



• Nail a specific native-FYP style from our reference library — casual, organic, scroll-stopping



• Work fluently with slideshows, text-on-screen, native captions, trending audio, and quick-cut footage



• Follow our naming, formatting, and delivery system precisely (clean operators win here)



• Hit daily output targets without the quality ever dropping



• Take feedback fast, iterate faster, and bring your own instincts for what makes a video hit







Who I'm looking for (non-negotiable) -



• Proven native-style short-form work — TikTok / Reels / Shorts in the casual, organic look (not brand promos). Your portfolio is the proof.



• Genuine speed with quality — you can produce volume without it ever looking mass-produced



• CapCut fluency (Premiere a plus) — fast, clean, precise



• Deep feel for TikTok pacing: 1-second hooks, fast cuts, native text styling, trend awareness



• Reliable daily availability and sharp, consistent communication



• Stable internet + a machine that handles daily video work without choking

title: SENIOR IT ENGINEER (MSP) - Projects, Networking, and Escalations - True North IT (Remote - Philippines)
description:
SENIOR IT ENGINEER (MSP)

Projects, Networking, and Escalations



We are a small MSP. Our clients are mostly in healthcare, manufacturing, and compliance focused industries, and they rely on us as their full IT department. Five people on the team. We are growing, and we are looking for a senior engineer who can own high level project work end to end and be the experienced hand the team brings the tougher problems to.



This is a senior role. Most of your week is project work, and a real part of it is being the person the team escalates to when something tricky comes in. We are looking for someone who can take a scope of work, think through the best approach, propose a solution, and run with it. Onboard a new client into our full service stack. Configure a Fortinet firewall remotely while a local tech racks the hardware. Harden a Microsoft 365 tenant for a client pursuing SOC 2 compliance. Document everything thoroughly so the next person does not have to start from scratch.



We value first principles thinking and expert troubleshooting. When you encounter a situation you have not seen before, we expect you to research it, reason through it, suggest your approach, and execute once we align. You will be solving real problems across a diverse client base, and no two weeks look the same.



You will work primarily on project deliverables, onboarding execution, and the escalations that need a senior set of hands. You like the ownership of running a project from scope to delivery, and you are also the person others can lean on when something hard comes in. As we get to know your work and your communication, there will be room to take on more responsibility over time.



What you will be doing



Full client onboardings: RMM deployment, M365 tenant baselining, security hardening, service stack tooling, documentation buildout.



Microsoft 365 security and identity work: conditional access policies, Entra ID configuration, compliance policies, DLP, MFA.



Remote network and firewall configuration: IP schema design, VLANs, security policies, VPN setup. Fortinet experience is ideal. UniFi familiarity is a plus.



Migration projects: tenant to tenant, Google to M365, IMAP, SharePoint, and on premises Active Directory to Entra ID.



Intune and endpoint management: enrollment, compliance policies, app deployment, Autopilot. Migrating endpoints from RMM only management to Intune managed. Apple Business Manager and MDM for macOS environments.



Automation and scripting. Building and maintaining scripts to streamline internal processes and client environments. You will also work with AI development tools on internal systems projects.



Escalations. Picking up the harder service board issues that need an experienced hand, during your overlap hours.



Documentation of everything you touch in our internal knowledge base.



What we are looking for



3 to 5 years or more in an MSP environment. You have managed multiple client tenants at once, worked within a PSA and ticketing system, and you understand the pace and context switching that comes with supporting a diverse client base.



Deep Microsoft 365 administration and security experience. Not just mailbox management. We mean conditional access, Entra ID, identity governance, compliance policies.



Real Intune proficiency: enrollment, compliance baselines, app deployment, Autopilot. Comfortable migrating endpoints from RMM only management into Intune managed environments.



Cybersecurity proficiency. You understand conditional access policy design, security baselines, MFA enforcement, and identity protection. Experience with HIPAA, SOC 2, or other compliance frameworks is important. We serve regulated industries and our clients depend on us to get this right.



Solid networking fundamentals with hands on firewall configuration experience. Fortinet preferred, others considered.



Migration experience across different scenarios: tenant to tenant, Google Workspace, IMAP, on premises Active Directory to Entra ID.



Automation and scripting experience. PowerShell, bash, or similar. You look for ways to automate repetitive work in tools like your RMM, PSA, or other platform APIs. Experience with AI coding tools or workflow automation platforms is a strong plus.



Excellent written and spoken English. You will be communicating with tea
mbers in the US in Teams throughout the day and occasionally joining client calls.



Strong documentation habits. If you did not document it, it did not happen.



First principles thinker. When something breaks or a project takes an unexpected turn, you research, reason through it, and come back with a recommended path forward.



Self directed. You receive a scope of work and we trust you to execute it, flag blockers, and submit milestones for review without being managed step by step.



Certifications



Microsoft SC-300 (Identity and Access Administrator) and MD-102 (Endpoint Administrator) within ninety days of hire, or a genuine willingness to earn them. We cover the exam fees and study materials. Holding either already puts you ahead.



Nice to have



Experience with any of our toolstack: NinjaRMM, HaloPSA, Huntress, ImmyBot, CIPP, Hudu.



Apple Business Manager and MDM experience for macOS endpoint management.



Fortinet NSE certification or equivalent.



Experience with AI coding tools, workflow automation, or building internal tooling. We are an AI forward team and actively building in this space.



What we offer



Full time remote work. $2,320 per month, with permanent pay increases tied to certifications earned. Exam fees and study materials covered. Interesting project work across a diverse client base. A team that communicates well and trusts you to own your work.



At least four hours of daily overlap with US Mountain Time, with flexibility for more during the onboarding period.



This role starts with a sixty day trial period so we can both make sure it is a good fit.



How to apply



To be considered, your application must include BOTH of these:



1. YOUR RESUME

2. A VIDEO, FIVE TO EIGHT MINUTES, ANSWERING ONE OF THE QUESTIONS BELOW



Both parts are required. The applications we move forward are the ones that include both your resume and your video, so please send them together in the same application. The video is the first thing we watch, so make sure it is there.



For the video, pick the ONE question below that fits you best and walk us through your approach. Use real examples from your own experience wherever you can. We care most about HOW you think, so talk us through it the way you would in a tea
eting with your peers. We are looking for candidates that can speak naturally about their experience, rather than just reading an AI script.



Answer ONE of these:



1. You are onboarding a 50 person company onto Microsoft 365. They are currently on Google Workspace. Walk us through your first two weeks: what you do, in what order, and the gotchas you would watch for.



2. A client needs a Fortinet firewall configured remotely. A local tech will rack it and give you console access. Walk us through how you would plan the deployment: IP schema, VLANs, security policies, and what you would document when you are done.



3. You are hardening a Microsoft 365 tenant for a client pursuing SOC 2 compliance. Which conditional access policies do you implement first, and why in that order?

title: Long-Form Video Editor — YouTube Content (Business / Agency Niche)
description:
The role



I run a UK-based marketing consultancy that publishes long-form business content on YouTube. I'm building out a proper content engine and need a reliable long-form editor to take over the editing side so I can focus on filming, strategy, and running the business.



Pay: $560/month

Schedule: 3–4 edited videos per week (roughly one every two days)

Video length: 10–30 minutes per edit

Start: ASAP



This is a recurring monthly role, not a one-off project. If you do good work and hit deadlines, this is stable, predictable work for the long term.



What you'll be editing



Long-form YouTube videos in the business / marketing / agency niche. Talking head + b-roll + screen recordings + occasional chart overlays.



The style is conversational, educational, direct — NOT high-energy MrBeast or hype-bro YouTube. The tone is British, calm, math-transparent, and anti-hype. Think Alex Hormozi's earlier long-form content or Sam Ovens — clean, professional, slightly opinionated, no flashy zoom-in-zoom-out every 3 seconds.



If you've ever edited "$10,000 in 30 days" type content, this is the opposite of that.



Your daily / weekly responsibilities





Receive raw footage in Google Drive (usually 30–60 min of raw ? 10–30 min edited)

Cut filler, dead air, ums/ahs, and mistakes

Build a tight, retention-focused first 30 seconds (this is the most important part of every edit — YouTube's primary distribution signal lives here)

Add b-roll from royalty-free sources (Pexels, Storyblocks) where it improves pacing

Add on-screen text overlays for key points, statistics, and frameworks

Colour correct talking head footage

Clean up audio (noise reduction, level balancing)

Add captions / subtitles (auto-generated, then manually corrected)

Export final and upload to a Google Drive output folder

Turnaround: deliver each finished edit within 48 hours of receiving raw footage





What you need to have



Required:





Adobe Premiere Pro OR DaVinci Resolve — fully proficient, not just basics

2+ years editing long-form YouTube content (not just shorts/reels)

Strong English comprehension — you'll be transcribing and editing British-accented audio

Reliable internet (you'll be downloading and uploading large files daily)

A track record of hitting deadlines without me having to chase you





Bonus (will move your application to the top of the pile):





Thumbnail design experience (Photoshop or Figma)

Experience cutting reels / shorts from long-form source files

Past work editing business, marketing, or agency content

Understanding of YouTube algorithm basics — retention curves, hook structure, CTR signals





What I'm NOT looking for





Editors who add flashy zoom-bounces, 
 sound effects, or constant motion graphics. Restraint is more valuable than flair on this channel.

Generic application messages with no portfolio links.

Anyone who needs to be chased for updates or misses deadlines.

Editors who only have experience with short-form / reels — I need someone who understands long-form pacing.

title: Operations & Client Coordination Assistant, Keep Clients Answered & Devs Moving
description:
About the business



I run a web design and development consultancy serving US-based clients. I handle strategy, design direction, client relationships, and sales. I also work with developers who help execute the web development projects.



The business is growing, but too many operational details still depend on me.



The real problem



Client requests, developer follow-ups, task tracking, timelines, invoices, and project updates all flow through me. When I get busy, replies take too long, completed work waits for review, invoices get delayed, and project details slip.



I need someone reliable to help run the operational layer around the work so I can focus on strategy, design, and sales.



Your job is to help make sure:



Clients get timely responses

Developers know exactly what needs to be done

Completed work doesn't sit unreviewed

Notion stays accurate

Invoices are prepared on time

I know what needs my attention each morning





What you'll do



Client communication support:



Monitor client requests in Gmail and other channels I give you access to

Draft replies, follow-ups, and project updates for my review

Prepare weekly client update drafts based on project progress

Send new-client welcome
s and help make sure the onboarding process runs smoothly

Flag anything urgent, unclear, or at risk of becoming a problem





Task and project coordination:



Turn client requests into clear internal tasks for developers

Keep Notion updated with tasks, statuses, owners, and deadlines

Watch for stalled tasks and follow up

Prepare a daily brief showing what needs attention, what's blocked, and what's next





Developer follow-up:



Monitor developer submissions

Check whether the delivered work matches the client request

Do basic QA: links, copy, responsive behavior, forms, screenshots, and obvious inconsistencies

If something is incomplete or unclear, ask the developer to fix or clarify it





Admin and invoicing:



Prepare invoices using my existing formula and template

Organize project notes and client information

Help document repeatable processes as SOPs while we work, so the system gets stronger over time





What this role is NOT:



This is not a passive "wait for instructions" role.



I need someone who follows up, notices when something is sitting too long, and reminds me when I'm the bottleneck. If a developer submission has been waiting for review, you ping me. If a client request is unclear, you flag it. If a deadline is getting close, you bring it up early. You help create the operating system around my work, so fewer things depend on my memory.



You won't make final decisions on client communication, scope, pricing, or invoices at first. I'll approve anything client-facing or financial before it goes out. But you'll own the preparation and the follow-up. As trust builds, you'll get more autonomy over routine decisions.



Requirements:



Excellent written English. You'll draft
s my US clients read. This is non-negotiable.

Strong attention to detail. The whole point is that nothing falls through the cracks.

Hands-on Notion experience. You should already know how to work in it.

Comfortable organizing tasks, deadlines, and project information.

Proactive communication. You follow up and don't go silent.

Comfortable working asynchronously across time zones.

Reliable internet (with a backup plan for outages) and a quiet setup for occasional video calls.

Bonus: experience with web design, web development, agencies, project coordination, or client service.





Working style



You should be structured, communicative, and comfortable reminding people (including me) when something needs attention. I'm looking for someone who creates order, not someone who needs every next step explained every day.



How to apply



Start your message with the word PROACTIVE. Applications that don't start with this word will be ignored.



Then answer these questions:



Tell me about one specific time you caught something before it became a problem. I want a real example, not a generic answer like "I always double-check my work."

Have you used Notion for task or project tracking? Describe how.

Write a short sample client update based on this situation: The homepage revisions are done and ready for the client to review. The mobile layout still needs one small adjustment, which the developer is handling today. You expect to send the final review link tomorrow.

What is your expected monthly salary for 20 hours/week?

Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a small paid test task, estimated at 60-90 minutes.

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper / Finance Operations Assistant — FreshBooks + Ramp

    * Business bank account

* Making sure transactions are categorized correctly

* Helping clean up the chart of accounts if needed

* Creating a clean process for ongoing bookkeeping going forward



Ongoing Weekly Work

* Processing and categorizing expenses

* Reconciling accounts on a regular basis

* Managing expenses and payments in Ramp

* Making sure expenses are attached to the correct project/event

* Reviewing receipts, vendors, and card transactions

* Flagging unusual, missing, or unclear transactions

Tools Used

/Teams 



Expected Hours

* Ongoing: approximately 3–4 hours per week

Ideal Candidate



The ideal person is:



* Experienced with bookkeeping for small businesses

* Strong with bank and credit card reconciliation

* Familiar with FreshBooks and Ramp, or able to learn quickly
