title: Ecommerce Finance & Operations Assistant
description:
# Ecommerce Finance & Operations Assistant for Shopify Clothing Brand



## About Us



Sunset Surf is a fast-growing clothing brand selling premium embroidered coastal hoodies. We are scaling through Shopify, Meta ads, creator content, inventory restocks, wholesale, and brand trips.



We are looking for a detail-oriented Ecommerce Finance & Operations Assistant who can help us track our business numbers clearly every week and every month.



This role is not a logistics role. We already have someone helping with logistics. This role is focused on tracking money, expenses, payments, inventory costs, QuickBooks, Shopify payouts, and monthly reports.



## What We Need Help With



We need someone who can help us clearly understand:



* How much money came in

* How much money went out

* How much we spent on inventory

* How much we spent on workers, creators, and contractors

* How much we spent on Meta ads

* How much we spent on brand trips

* How much cash is tied up in inventory

* How much inventory has sold

* How much inventory is still left to sell

* Estimated monthly profit

* Upcoming payments and expenses



The goal is to help us see a clear picture of the business every week and month.



## Main Responsibilities



* Track Shopify sales and payouts

* Compare Shopify payouts to bank deposits

* Track QuickBooks transactions

* Organize and categorize expenses in QuickBooks

* Track inventory purchases

* Track cost per hoodie/SKU

* Track how much cash is tied up in inventory

* Track units sold and units remaining

* Track creator, contractor, and worker payments

* Track Meta ad spend

* Track product/sample costs

* Track brand trip spending

* Track receipts and invoices

* Maintain Google Sheets or Excel trackers

* Prepare weekly financial summaries

* Prepare monthly spending and profit summaries

* Flag missing expenses, unusual payments, or cash-flow concerns

* Work with our bookkeeper/CPA when needed



## Initial Project



The first project will be to organize and track financial data from January 1st of this year to present.



This includes:



* Shopify payouts

* Business expenses

* Inventory purchases

* Creator/contractor payments

* Worker payments

* Meta ad spend

* Brand trip expenses

* Software/app subscriptions

* Product/sample costs

* Monthly summaries



After the initial setup, this will become an ongoing weekly and monthly tracking role.



## Brand Trip Tracking



For brand trips, we mainly need spending tracked clearly.



You will track:



* Trip name

* Location

* Date

* Budget

* Flights

* Hotel/Airbnb

* Food

* Uber/rental car

* Activities

* Creator payments

* Products gifted

* Photographer/videographer costs

* Decorations/props

* Miscellaneous expenses

* Total spent

* Whether the trip was over or under budget

* Receipts and payment dates



We want to clearly see how much we are spending on brand trips each month.



## Inventory Tracking Example



If we buy 1,000 hoodies at $30 each, that is $30,000 spent upfront.



If each hoodie sells for $99, that inventory has $99,000 in potential revenue.



We need help tracking:



* Total inventory cost

* Units received

* Units sold

* Units remaining

* Revenue generated so far

* Remaining inventory value

* How much cash is still tied up in inventory



This helps us understand where our money is and how much inventory still needs to sell.



## Tools You Should Know



You must be comfortable with:



* QuickBooks

* Shopify

* Google Sheets or Excel

* Basic ecommerce reporting

* Expense tracking

* Cash-flow tracking



Experience with these is a bonus:



* Meta Ads Manager

* TrueProfit

* BeProfit

* Inventory Planner

* Settle

* Finaloop

* Ecommerce bookkeeping

* Apparel or clothing brands

* Inventory/COGS tracking



## Ideal Candidate



You are a good fit if you are:



* Very organized

* Strong with numbers

* Experienced with QuickBooks

* Experienced with Shopify

* Comfortable with spreadsheets

* Detail-oriented

* Reliable with weekly updates

* Good at spotting missing expenses or mistakes

* Comfortable asking questions when something does not make sense

* Able to create simple, clear reports

* Experienced with ecommerce businesses



## Important



You will not have control over bank transfers or final payment approvals.



Your role is to track, organize, report, and help us understand the numbers.



Final payments, banking decisions, tax decisions, and accounting decisions will be handled by the owner and/or bookkeeper/CPA.



## Weekly Report



Every week, we want a simple report showing:



* Total sales

* Total Shopify payouts

* Total expenses

* Meta ad spend

* Creator/contractor/worker payments

* Inventory payments

* Brand trip expenses

* Estimated profit

* Upcoming bills/payments

* Any missing receipts or concerns

* Any cash-flow notes



## Monthly Report



Every month, we want a summary showing:



* Total revenue

* Total expenses

* Estimated profit

* Inventory purchased

* Inventory sold

* Cash tied up in inventory

* Creator/content spend

* Worker/contractor spend

* Brand trip spend

* Ad spend

* Software/app expenses

* Areas where we may be overspending

* Big payments coming up next month



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your experience with Shopify

2. Your experience with QuickBooks

3. Examples of ecommerce finance, bookkeeping, or operations tracking work you have done

4. Your experience with inventory, COGS, or cash-flow tracking

5. Your experience with Google Sheets or Excel

6. Your hourly or monthly rate

7. Your availability

8. Any ecommerce finance tools you recommend



Please also answer this question:



If a brand spends $30,000 on inventory upfront, but that inventory will sell over the next few months, how would you track that so the owner understands both cash flow and profit?



Thank you!

title: Photo Ad Designer for Shopify Clothing Brand
description:
# Photo Ad Designer for Shopify Clothing Brand



## About Us



Sunset Surf is a fast-growing clothing brand selling premium embroidered coastal hoodies. We are scaling through Shopify, Meta ads, creator content, product launches, and brand trips.



We are looking for a creative photo ad designer who can design high-performing static ads for Meta, Instagram,
, and other paid/social channels.



This role is focused on creating simple, clean, high-converting photo ads using product photos, lifestyle photos, creator images, review screenshots, product details, and ad copy.



## Role Overview



We need someone who can create strong static ads that feel premium, scroll-stopping, and on-brand.



You will help turn our products, photos, reviews, and marketing angles into ad creatives that can be tested in Meta ads.



The goal is not just to make pretty designs. The goal is to create photo ads that get attention, communicate the value of the product quickly, and help drive purchases.



## Main Responsibilities



* Design static photo ads for Meta/Facebook/Instagram

* Create product-focused ad creatives

* Create lifestyle/photo-based ad creatives

* Create review/testimonial ad creatives

* Create sale, restock, launch, and best-seller ads

* Create embroidery/detail-focused ads

* Create simple ad variations using different hooks, headlines, layouts, and images

* Resize ads for different placements when needed

* Keep designs clean, premium, and easy to read

* Work with provided product photos, creator photos, brand assets, and ad concepts

* Organize final creatives in folders

* Create multiple variations for testing

* Follow brand direction and improve based on ad performance feedback



## Types of Ads We Need



Examples of static ads we want to test:



* Product photo ads

* Lifestyle photo ads

* Review/testimonial ads

* Before/after or comparison-style ads

* “Embroidered, not printed” ads

* “Your new favorite hoodie” ads

* “The hoodie brand of the summer” ads

* “Feels like wearing a blanket” ads

* Best-seller ads

* Restock ads

* Limited drop ads

* Carousel graphics

* Simple creator-photo ads

* Social proof ads

* Detail/close-up embroidery ads



## Design Style



We are looking for designs that feel:



* Clean

* Premium

* Coastal

* Fun

* Bright

* Modern

* Easy to read

* Not overly corporate

* Not cluttered

* Strong enough for paid ads



The ads should feel like they fit a beachy/coastal clothing brand, but still be direct and conversion-focused.



## Tools You Should Know



You should be experienced with:



* Canva, Photoshop, Figma, or Adobe Illustrator

* Designing for Meta ads

* Designing for Instagram/Facebook

* Basic direct response ad design

* Working with product photography

* Creating multiple creative variations quickly



Bonus if you have experience with:



* Shopify brands

* Clothing/apparel brands

* Fashion or lifestyle ads

* Meta ad creatives

* UGC-style static ads

* Ecommerce conversion design

* Creative testing

* Klaviyo/email graphics



## What We Will Provide



We can provide:



* Product photos

* Lifestyle photos

* Creator photos

* Brand colors/fonts

* Product benefits

* Winning ad angles

* Customer reviews

* Examples of ad styles we like

* Creative direction

* Feedback based on ad performance



## Weekly Deliverables



We are looking for someone who can consistently create batches of static ads.



Example deliverables may include:



* 10–20 static ad designs per week

* Multiple variations of winning concepts

* Resized versions for placements when needed

* Organized files and editable source files



The exact weekly volume can be discussed based on your availability, pricing, and speed.



## Ideal Candidate



You are a good fit if you:



* Have strong visual design skills

* Understand ecommerce ads

* Can design for conversion, not just aesthetics

* Are fast and organized

* Can take direction and feedback

* Can create multiple ad variations

* Understand clean typography and layout

* Know how to make product benefits clear quickly

* Have experience designing for Meta/Facebook/Instagram ads

* Can match a brand style while still testing new creative angles



## Important



We are not looking for overly complicated designs.



Many of the best-performing ads are simple, clear, and direct.



We need someone who can create designs that quickly communicate why someone would want the hoodie, such as:



* Soft fleece inside

* Premium quality

* Detailed embroidery

* Coastal/beachy designs

* Comfortable fit

* Easy to style

* Great for everyday wear



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your design portfolio

2. Examples of ecommerce or clothing brand ads you have designed

3. Your experience designing Meta/Facebook/Instagram ads

4. What tools you use

5. Your weekly availability

6. Your rate per design, per batch, or per month

7. How many static ads you can create per week

8. Your favorite style of ad creative to design



Please also answer this question:



If we gave you one hoodie product photo, one customer review, and one product benefit, how would you turn that into 3 different static ad concepts?



Thank you!

title: High-Retention YouTube Video Editor for Outdoor / Hunting Channel
description:
I am looking for an excellent YouTube video editor for an outdoor, hunting, survival, and precision shooting channel.



I will provide the footage, thumbnails, titles, and AI video clips when needed. Your job is to turn the raw footage into a highly engaging, fast-paced, professional YouTube video that keeps viewers watching.



This is not basic editing. I need someone who understands YouTube retention editing, fast pacing, storytelling, jump cuts, captions, sound design, and pattern interrupts.



Main Responsibilities:



You will edit long-form YouTube videos using footage such as:



Outdoor hunting footage

Scope-cam footage

Reenactment footage

Talking-head clips

B-roll

AI-generated clips that I provide

Voiceover

Natural audio

Music and sound effects

You must be able to create a clean story sequence, such as:



Strong hook in the first 3 seconds

Fast setup

Outdoor/scouting footage

Reenactment angle

Scope-cam footage

Reaction shot

Explanation

Lesson learned

Call to action

Introduction / Retention Hook Requirements (Very Important):



The first 30–60 seconds of every video are critical. I want intros inspired by high-retention outdoor creators such as Outdoor Boys, where viewers immediately feel that something exciting, surprising, or high-stakes is about to happen.



The intro should use the best 
nts from the video as teasers before the main story begins, including:



Quick flashes of the biggest payoff 
nts

Scope-cam highlights

Close calls, reactions, or unexpected 
nts

Cinematic outdoor shots

Strong sound design and music builds

Fast pacing with curiosity-driven editing

The goal is to make viewers think: “I need to see how this turns out.”



You should be able to build a compelling cold open that increases audience retention before transitioning smoothly into the main story.



Editing Style I Want:



I want a very high-retention YouTube editing style where something visually changes every 3–7 seconds to keep the viewer engaged.



This can include:



Jump cuts

Punch-ins / zoom cuts

B-roll

Captions

Sound effects

Music changes

Camera angle changes

Text overlays

Motion graphics

Quick visual resets

Pattern interrupts

Cutting dead space aggressively

The video should feel fast, clean, cinematic, and addictive — but not childish or sloppy.



Very Important: Best-Take Editing



Sometimes I record in one long take and repeat the same sentence multiple times until I say it correctly.



You must be able to:



Remove rambling

Remove awkward pauses

Remove bad takes

Remove repeated sentences

Remove filler words when needed

Choose the best version of each sentence

Make the final video sound natural and smooth

I need someone who can turn messy raw footage into a sharp final video.



Short-Form Editing:



You may also be asked to create short clips for:



YouTube Shorts

TikTok

Instagram Reels

 Reels

Shorts should have:



Strong hook in the first 1 second

Fast cuts

Captions

Zooms

Sound effects

Clear payoff

Loopable ending when possible

Software Experience Preferred:



Please apply if you are skilled with one or more of these:



Adobe Premiere Pro

DaVinci Resolve

CapCut

Final Cut Pro

Descript

Gling

FireCut

After Effects is a plus

You do not need to create thumbnails.

You do not need to create AI videos.

You do not need to write the scripts.



Your main job is excellent video editing and retention.



Required Skills:



Excellent YouTube video editing ability

Strong pacing

Strong storytelling

Good English comprehension

Ability to choose the best takes

Ability to cut boring footage aggressively

Ability to make outdoor footage exciting

Ability to sync scope-cam footage, reenactment footage, and talking footage

Good sound design

Good captions

Fast turnaround time

Attention to detail

Willingness to revise edits

Bonus Skills:

Experience creating viral Shorts/Reels

Experience with retention editing

Experience with sound design

The software you use

“I understand retention editing.”

You prompt your own AI images so they look real, not like AI slop.

You prompt the best AI voices in ElevenLabs and build clean, real-sounding AI avatars in HeyGen, with lipsync that actually matches.

You are at the tip of the iceberg on current Meta ads formats and visuals, and you keep up as the tools change.







What every video you ship has



You build scroll stopping VSLs, 3 to 10 minutes long, that feel like content and not like an ad. Every video has:



A hook in the first 3 seconds that stops the scroll, then a story and pacing that holds attention all the way to the offer.

High quality effects and edits, done cleanly, never cheap or overdone.

Strong scene selection. You know exactly which scenes to use for each part of the video and why, and you understand what visual needs to be on screen at every 
nt to keep the customer watching.

Hyper realistic AI b-roll and images, AI avatars, and AI voices with real emotion. No robotic voices, no fake-looking visuals.

Clean, styled captions plus music and SFX that hit on the beats and lift the emotion.

Delivered ready to upload in the placements we run (typically 9:16 and 4:5), with everything burned in.







You understand the customer and you have taste



Once you know our target customer, you build the whole video to resonate with exactly that person, without being told how. You pick the avatar, the voice, the visuals, and the tone that match who we are selling to. If we are targeting older men, you instinctively choose an avatar, voice, and style that lands with older men. If we are targeting young women, you choose differently. You get it right because you actually understand the customer.

You know the difference between high quality visuals and bad AI slop, and you only ship the good stuff. You have real taste and you do not need me to tell you what looks good.







Training (required for this role)



You have real training and a background from Ecom Talent or a similar ecommerce Meta ads editing course or community. This role is for people who have already put in the reps to learn these specific skills, so this is not just a nice-to-have here.







How fast you need to move



This is high volume. We push out a lot of concepts, so you need to turn around full VSLs quickly and consistently, e.g. 10 to 20 videos per week, full VSL within 24 to 48 hours. Fast execution at a high standard is the whole job. If you are slow or you need a lot of revisions to get it right, this is not the role for you.







Pay, bonuses, and growth



$6 per finished video.

Cash bonuses on top when an ad you made wins and scales.

Full time, not part time, because of the volume needed.

Pay is sent every 2 weeks for the first month, then weekly from month 2.

After month 1, the best editor moves into a paid lead role building our SOPs and training a team of 5 to 10 editors, at significantly higher pay.







Do not apply if



You are not an experienced direct response Meta ads editor.

You are a general video editor or a beginner.

You cannot prompt your own AI video, images, voices, and avatars to a high standard.

Your English is not strong. You need to speak and understand English clearly. I am not going back and forth dealing with miscommunication.







How to apply (read this carefully)



Do not send me a profile, a resume, or a portfolio link. Show me you can actually do the work.



Send one Google Doc (make sure commenter access is on) that shows and explains at least 5 different styles of your best work. For example a voiceover b-roll VSL, a clay AI animation, a skeleton AI animation, a Pixar style AI animation, and an AI avatar ad, all for direct response Meta ads brands. Send what you personally believe is your best work, whether or not it was the best performing. I just want to see how good you actually are.



At the bottom of that same doc, add your single highest performing Meta ads edit that you made yourself, with the result if you have it.



Send a 30 second Loom with your camera on, showing your face, telling me in clear English why I should hire you over the other editors based on your specific skills.



I am onboarding within 24 to 40 hours and it is first come first served, so send it fast pls.



Text me on WhatsApp at 
and start your message with the word CONVERT. Do NOT message me through OnlineJobs, there are too many messages there and yours will get lost.



My name's Xanth.

title: Admin Assistant / Junior Bookkeeper
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Our approach is built on accuracy, clear communication, and strong client relationships, and these core values guide how we serve clients and work as a team.

mber who will take pride in their work, value organization and problem-solving, and want to contribute to delivering high-quality financial support to our clients.





POSITION SUMMARY



The Administrative Assistant / Junior Bookkeeper is an entry level position responsible for providing administrative and bookkeeping support to ensure the smooth day-to-day operations of the firm. This role includes assisting with client onboarding, organizing and maintaining digital files, performing basic bookkeeping tasks, and supporting the Head Bookkeeper with recurring monthly work.

Responsibilities may include categorizing transactions, reconciling accounts, entering data into QuickBooks Online, processing payroll, managing some client communications, maintaining internal systems and checklists, and assisting with special projects as needed. The Administrative Assistant / Junior Bookkeeper will also help ensure client records are complete, organized, and up to date while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

This role is ideal for someone who is organized, dependable, eager to learn, and excited to grow within the firm long-term. Prior experience with QuickBooks Online is preferred but not required, as training will be provided for the right candidate.

We are not looking for a highly experienced candidate. Instead, we are seeking someone who is eager to learn, grow with our firm, and contribute to our team long-term. The ideal candidate has a positive, can-do attitude, is willing to learn, and takes initiative. Above all, we value enthusiasm, reliability, and exceptional attention to detail over years of experience.





OBJECTIVES & RESPONSIBILITIES



The Administrative Assistant / Junior Bookkeeper is responsible for providing administrative and bookkeeping support while ensuring accuracy, organization, and timely completion of assigned tasks. Responsibilities include:



• Assist with categorizing income and expenses using cash-basis and/or accrual accounting.

• Maintain client bookkeeping files by reviewing and organizing bank feed transactions.

• Categorize and match transactions in QuickBooks Online under the guidance of the Head Bookkeeper.

• Identify missing receipts or supporting documentation and follow up as directed.

• Assist with bank and credit card reconciliations.

• Maintain organized digital files for receipts, statements, and other client documentation.

• Assist with client onboarding by organizing files, requesting documents, and setting up client information.

• Monitor and respond to
 communication from tea
mbers and clients within 24 hours during scheduled working days.

• Promptly communicate questions, discrepancies, or concerns to the Head Bookkeeper for review.

• Follow established standard operating procedures (SOPs) and internal workflows.

• Demonstrate a willingness to learn new bookkeeping skills, software, and processes through ongoing training.

• Maintain a high level of accuracy, confidentiality, and professionalism in all work performed.

• Prepare for and participate in biweekly one-on-one meetings with the Head Bookkeeper to discuss progress, questions, and opportunities for improvement.

• Maintain an accurate record of hours worked and provide daily updates on completed tasks.

• Perform additional administrative or bookkeeping responsibilities as assigned.



The Administrative Assistant / Junior Bookkeeper is expected to ask questions when unsure, seek clarification when needed, and continually develop their bookkeeping and administrative skills while providing dependable support to the firm and clients.





QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE



The ideal Administrative Assistant / Junior Bookkeeper will possess the following qualifications, skills, and attributes:

• Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred but not required.

• 1+ years of administrative, bookkeeping, accounting support, or customer service experience is preferred.

• Basic understanding of bookkeeping principles and a willingness to continue learning.

• Strong computer skills with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace.

• Experience with cloud-based software such as Gusto, Zoom, LastPass, Double, or similar applications is a plus.

title: Strategic Project Manager – EV Infrastructure & Vehicle Inspection
description:
Job Summary:

We are seeking an analytical, process-driven Strategic Project Manager to act as the primary gatekeeper and operational architect for our upcoming initiatives. In this role, you will evaluate incoming opportunities in the EV charging station and vehicle inspection spaces, analyzing them against our strategic goals and past performance to determine viability ("Should we pursue this project?").



You won't just manage timelines—you will be responsible for deconstructing complex project scopes, identifying technical and utility requirements, reviewing or creating winning commercial proposals, and designing step-by-step Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). The ideal candidate combines a background in technical project management (infrastructure, utilities, or fleet operations) with a rigorous approach to process standardisation.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Project Evaluation & Feasibility Analysis (Go/No-Go)



Critically evaluate new project leads for charging station installations and vehicle inspection programs to assess financial profitability, technical viability, and operational capacity.



Review prospective station sites or fleet sizes against our historical data to advise leadership on whether a project makes strategic sense to pursue.



Factor in variables like utility grid capacity, local zoning laws, inspection volume, and regional compliance factors during initial evaluation phases.



2. Technical Scope Breakdown & Requirements Gathering



Deconstruct high-level project requests into highly technical, executable project scopes.



Map out exact requirements for EV charging deployment (e.g., electrical load demands, transformer upgrades, hardware/software interoperability, ADA compliance).



Identify exact criteria for vehicle inspection setups (e.g., diagnostic tool integration, physical lane layouts, safety testing compliance, data management systems).



Pinpoint project bottlenecks, supply chain constraints (hardware lead times), and permitting risks early on.



3. Proposal Creation & Review



Draft thorough, professional project proposals, Requests for Proposals (RFPs), and Statements of Work (SOWs) for clients, municipal entities, or enterprise fleet partners.



Conduct strict reviews of internally created proposals to ensure cost estimates, deployment timelines, and resource allocations are realistic and protect the company from scope creep.



4. Process Optimization & SOP Development



Build out a library of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for newly approved projects to ensure seamless, highly repeatable field execution.



Author SOPs for charging station installation, site commissioning, safety testing, and post-install maintenance.



Create standardized workflows, inspection checklists, and software training SOPs for vehicle inspection technicians to ensure quality control and regulatory compliance.



Qualifications & Experience:

Experience: 4+ years of project management or operations management experience, specifically within EV charging infrastructure, civil/electrical construction, fleet management, or automotive service/inspection programs.



Analytical Assessment: Strong ability to read technical site plans, utility sheets, or fleet specifications and make data-driven decisions on project feasibility.



Documentation Excellence: Proven track record of drafting complex proposals, SOWs, and creating highly structured, clear SOPs for technical workflows.



Regulatory/Technical Knowledge: * Familiarity with EV charging infrastructure (Level 2 & DC Fast Charging, utility interconnection, permitting).



Familiarity with automotive/vehicle inspection standards, diagnostic equipment, or compliance regulations is a major asset.



Tools: Proficiency with project management platforms (e.g., ClickUp, Asana, Jira, Monday.com) and visual process mapping tools (e.g., Lucidchart, Miro).



Certification: PMP, Lean Six Sigma (Green or Black Belt), or CAPM is highly preferred.



Who You Are:

The Strategic Gatekeeper: You know how to look past the excitement of a new deal and evaluate whether it actually makes financial and operational sense for the team to execute.



Detail-Obsessed: You care about the nuance of a utility grid connection or the exact calibration steps of a vehicle inspection tool, ensuring no detail is missed in the scope.



A Process Creator: You thrive on turning a chaotic, "one-off" project execution into a repeatable, step-by-step SOP system that anyone on the team can follow.



An Effective Communicator: You can easily align utility companies, electrical contractors, inspection technicians, and executive stakeholders on a singular vision.

title: Executive Personal Assistant — Business Owner
description:
I'm a UK-based business owner running a marketing consultancy. I need a sharp, proactive personal assistant to handle the lifestyle and operational tasks that keep me functional — so I can focus on running my businesses without spending my time on admin, research, and scheduling.



Pay: $560/month

Hours: ~7 to 10 per week 

Start: ASAP



This is a long-term, recurring role. If you do good work, this is stable monthly income for as long as you want it.



What you'll actually be doing



A mix of operational and lifestyle tasks. Some examples of typical requests:





Travel: "Book me a flight London Gatwick to Larnaca next Friday returning Tuesday, prefer morning departures, business class." You handle the research, options, booking, calendar entry, confirmation tracking.

Property: "Find me 5 three-bed houses in Limassol with a pool, under €1.2m. Send a shortlist with photos, prices, and key details." You compile the shortlist.

Weekend trips: "Plan a long weekend in Athens. Hotel, 3 dinners, 2 day activities, total budget €3k." You design the itinerary.

Restaurants: "Find me the best Mediterranean restaurants in Nicosia under €100/head with outdoor seating." You research and send a shortlist with reservations links.

Schedule management: Keep my calendar organized, block out focus time, reschedule conflicts proactively, remind me of upcoming commitments before I forget them.

Operational support: Track recurring deadlines (passport renewals, business filings, subscription reviews), maintain my contact lists, manage personal admin.





The role evolves — what's repetitive becomes automated, new things get added. You need to be the kind of person who builds the system, not the kind who waits to be told.



What separates a great applicant from a mediocre one



The best PA I've worked with thinks two steps ahead. If I ask for a flight, they include a hotel option too. If I'
eting someone in a new city, they pre-emptively send the address, parking info, and a backup café in case the first venue is closed. Reactive PAs send what I asked for; great PAs anticipate what I'll need next.



If that sounds like how you naturally operate, this role will work for you. If you need a detailed brief for every single task, it won't.



What you need to have



Required:





Excellent written English — you'll be drafting
s, making reservations, talking to UK and European service providers. This is the deal-breaker. If your English is weak, please don't apply, I'll just have to redo your work.

Strong research skills — comfortable finding flights, properties, restaurants, services across multiple platforms

Highly organized — Google Calendar, Notion, basic spreadsheets, project tracking

Timezone overlap — must be available during UK working hours (most of your work day overlaps GMT/BST or CET)

Discretion — you'll know personal details. Stay professional.

Proactive personality — you anticipate, you don't wait to be asked





Bonus (will move you to the top):





Previous experience supporting a founder, CEO, or high-net-worth individual

Travel planning experience (booking platforms, loyalty programs, international logistics)

Familiarity with UK or European geography, restaurants, and culture

Experience with property research (RightMove, Bayut, Zillow, etc.)

Schengen / European travel knowledge





What I'm NOT looking for





"I can do anything" applications with no specifics

VAs who need step-by-step instructions for every task

Anyone who can't handle ambiguity ("Find me a good restaurant" should not result in 47 follow-up questions)

Generic copy-paste applications
